products.name: MF833V
products.zh: 全球性行业应用首选。USB-A，LTE Cat.4。
products.en: The first choice for global industrial use. USB-A, LTE Cat 4.

products.name: Dongle 400
products.zh: 为工业 AR 眼镜而生。USB Type-C，IP66。
products.en: Built for industrial AR glasses. USB Type-C, IP66.

products.name: F40
products.zh: 轻量级 5G 联网神器。5G RedCap（需 5G SA），4G 作应急备用。
products.en: Lightweight 5G RedCap dongle (needs 5G SA); 4G as emergency fallback.

modules.name: Huawei E5576-320
modules.text: LTE B1 B3 B7 B8 B20 B28 B38
modules.note_zh: 最常见的出行随身 Wi-Fi 之一；没有北美的 B2、B4、B12、B66、B71，也不支持 2G。
modules.note_en: One of the most common travel pocket Wi-Fi units; no North American B2, B4, B12, B66 or B71, and no 2G.

modules.name: Huawei E5577-320
modules.text: LTE B1 B3 B7 B8 B20 B28 B38 B40 B41

modules.name: TP-Link M7350
modules.text: LTE B1 B3 B7 B8 B20
modules.note_zh: 没有 B28：在依赖 700 MHz 做覆盖的国家（如澳大利亚、拉美多国）乡村信号会弱。
modules.note_en: No B28: in countries that rely on 700 MHz for coverage (Australia, much of Latin America) the rural signal will be weak.

modules.name: TP-Link M7450
modules.text: LTE B1 B3 B7 B8 B20 B38 B40 B41

modules.name: Quectel RM520N-GL
modules.note_zh: 5G 全功能（eMBB，NSA 与 SA）而非 RedCap；B29、B32 与 n29、n75、n76 只用于下行。
modules.note_en: Full 5G (eMBB, NSA and SA), not RedCap; B29, B32 and n29, n75, n76 are downlink only.

modules.name: Quectel EG912U-GL
modules.text: LTE B1 B2 B3 B4 B5 B7 B8 B12 B13 B17 B18 B19 B20 B25 B26 B28 B66 B34 B38 B39 B40 B41

modules.name: Quectel BG77
modules.text: LTE-M NB-IoT B1 B2 B3 B4 B5 B8 B12 B13 B14 B18 B19 B20 B25 B26 B27 B28 B66 B71 B85
modules.note_zh: LTE-M 与 NB-IoT 合并评估：B14、B26、B27 只用于 LTE-M，B71、B85 只用于 NB-IoT。
modules.note_en: LTE-M and NB-IoT are assessed together: B14, B26 and B27 are LTE-M only, B71 and B85 are NB-IoT only.

modules.name: Quectel BG770A-GL
modules.text: LTE-M NB-IoT B1 B2 B3 B4 B5 B8 B12 B13 B17 B18 B19 B20 B25 B26 B27 B28 B66
modules.note_zh: LTE-M 与 NB-IoT 合并评估：B26、B27 只用于 LTE-M，B17 只用于 NB-IoT。
modules.note_en: LTE-M and NB-IoT are assessed together: B26 and B27 are LTE-M only, B17 is NB-IoT only.

modules.name: Quectel EG25-G
modules.text: LTE B1 B2 B3 B4 B5 B7 B8 B12 B13 B18 B19 B20 B25 B26 B28 B38 B39 B40 B41

modules.name: SIMCom SIM7600G-H
modules.text: LTE B1 B2 B3 B4 B5 B7 B8 B12 B13 B18 B19 B20 B25 B26 B28 B66 B34 B38 B39 B40 B41

modules.name: Quectel BG95-M3
modules.text: LTE-M NB-IoT B1 B2 B3 B4 B5 B8 B12 B13 B18 B19 B20 B25 B26 B27 B28 B66 B71 B85
modules.note_zh: LTE-M 与 NB-IoT 合并评估：它的 LTE-M 另含 B26、B27，NB-IoT 另含 B71。
modules.note_en: LTE-M and NB-IoT are assessed together: its LTE-M also has B26 and B27, its NB-IoT also has B71.

modules.name: Quectel EG915U-EU
modules.text: LTE B1 B3 B5 B7 B8 B20 B28

modules.name: u-blox SARA-R510M8S
modules.text: LTE-M NB-IoT B1 B2 B3 B4 B5 B8 B12 B13 B18 B19 B20 B25 B26 B28 B66 B71 B85
modules.note_zh: LTE-M 与 NB-IoT 合并评估：B25 只用于 LTE-M，B66、B71、B85 只用于 NB-IoT；“00”版本不支持 NB-IoT。
modules.note_en: LTE-M and NB-IoT are assessed together: B25 is LTE-M only, B66, B71 and B85 are NB-IoT only, and the “00” versions do not support NB-IoT.

modules.name: Nordic nRF9160
modules.text: LTE-M NB-IoT B1 B2 B3 B4 B5 B8 B12 B13 B14 B17 B18 B19 B20 B25 B26 B28 B66
modules.note_zh: 频段为 Nordic 公布的已获认证频段；LTE-M 与 NB-IoT 合并评估。
modules.note_en: Bands are those Nordic lists as certified so far; LTE-M and NB-IoT are assessed together.

modules.name: Quectel EC25-E
modules.text: LTE B1 B3 B5 B7 B8 B20 B38 B40 B41
modules.note_zh: EC25-E 没有 B28；需要 B28（澳大利亚、新西兰、以色列等）请选同系列的 EC25-EU 或 EC25-EUX。
modules.note_en: The EC25-E has no B28; where B28 is needed (Australia, New Zealand, Israel and others), choose the EC25-EU or EC25-EUX from the same family.

modules.name: Quectel EC200U-EU
modules.text: LTE B1 B3 B5 B7 B8 B20 B28 B38 B40 B41
modules.note_zh: 同系列的 EC200U-AU 另带 B2、B4、B66，EC200U-CN 面向中国。
modules.note_en: In the same family, the EC200U-AU adds B2, B4 and B66, and the EC200U-CN is for China.

modules.name: SIMCom A7670E
modules.text: LTE B1 B3 B5 B7 B8 B20
modules.note_zh: A7670E 没有 B28 和美洲频段；需要时请选同系列的 A7670SA（B1/2/3/4/5/7/8/28/66）。
modules.note_en: The A7670E has no B28 and no Americas bands; where they are needed, choose the A7670SA from the same family (B1/2/3/4/5/7/8/28/66).

modules.name: SIMCom SIM7080G
modules.text: LTE-M NB-IoT B1 B2 B3 B4 B5 B8 B12 B13 B14 B18 B19 B20 B25 B26 B27 B28 B66 B71 B85
modules.note_zh: LTE-M 与 NB-IoT 合并评估：B14、B27 只用于 LTE-M，B71 只用于 NB-IoT；SIM7080G-M 只支持 LTE-M。
modules.note_en: LTE-M and NB-IoT are assessed together: B14 and B27 are LTE-M only, B71 is NB-IoT only, and the SIM7080G-M supports LTE-M only.

modules.name: Quectel BG96
modules.text: LTE-M NB-IoT B1 B2 B3 B4 B5 B8 B12 B13 B18 B19 B20 B25 B26 B28 B39
modules.note_zh: LTE-M 与 NB-IoT 合并评估：B39 只用于 LTE-M；B25 需要 R1.2 及以后的版本；BG96-M 只支持 LTE-M。
modules.note_en: LTE-M and NB-IoT are assessed together: B39 is LTE-M only, B25 needs release R1.2 or later, and the BG96-M supports LTE-M only.

modules.name: Quectel EG21-G
modules.text: LTE B1 B2 B3 B4 B5 B7 B8 B12 B13 B18 B19 B20 B25 B26 B28 B38 B39 B40 B41
modules.note_zh: 4G 频段与 EG25-G 相同，速率为 Cat 1（最高 10 Mbps），适合数据量小、看重成本的设备。
modules.note_en: The same 4G bands as the EG25-G at Cat 1 speed (up to 10 Mbit/s), suited to low-data, cost-sensitive devices.

modules.name: u-blox LARA-R6001D
modules.text: LTE B1 B2 B3 B4 B5 B7 B8 B12 B13 B18 B19 B20 B26 B28 B38 B39 B40 B41
modules.note_zh: D 版只传数据、不支持语音；北美项目可选同系列的 LARA-R6401（含 B14、B66、B71）。
modules.note_en: The D version is data only; for North America, the LARA-R6401 in the same family adds B14, B66 and B71.

modules.name: Telit ME910C1-WW
modules.text: LTE-M NB-IoT B1 B2 B3 B4 B5 B8 B12 B13 B18 B19 B20 B26 B28
modules.note_zh: LTE-M 与 NB-IoT 合并评估；新一代 ME910G1 系列增加了 B25、B66、B85 等北美频段，各版本频段不同，选型时请核对。
modules.note_en: LTE-M and NB-IoT are assessed together; the newer ME910G1 family adds North American bands such as B25, B66 and B85, and its versions differ, so check before choosing.

modules.name: Quectel RG255C-GL
modules.note_zh: 规格书为预发布版本；已通过 T-Mobile 网络认证。5G 需要运营商开通 5G SA 与 RedCap，其他网络用 LTE Cat 4 回落。
modules.note_en: The specification is a preliminary release; the module is certified on T-Mobile. 5G needs 5G SA with RedCap on the network; elsewhere it falls back to LTE Cat 4.

modules.name: Teltonika TRB140 (0*****)
modules.text: LTE B1 B3 B7 B8 B20 B28 B38 B40 B41
modules.note_zh: 官方写作 B28A，即 700 MHz 的下半段；少数只用 B28 上半段的运营商可能连不上。北美与拉美请选其他版本。
modules.note_en: Listed by the maker as B28A, the lower half of 700 MHz; the few operators using only the upper half of B28 may not work. For the Americas, choose another version.

modules.name: Teltonika TRB140 (1*****)
modules.text: LTE B1 B2 B3 B4 B5 B7 B8 B28 B40
modules.note_zh: 没有 B20（欧洲 800 MHz 覆盖层）：在欧洲城区可用，但郊区和室内覆盖会变差；也没有 B12、B13、B66、B71，不适合美国。
modules.note_en: No B20 (the 800 MHz coverage layer in Europe): it works in European cities, but suburban and indoor coverage will be weaker; and no B12, B13, B66 or B71, so not for the United States.

modules.name: Teltonika RUTX12 (0*****)
modules.text: LTE B1 B3 B5 B7 B8 B20 B28 B38 B40 B41
modules.note_zh: 官方还列有 B32（1500 MHz），但只能接收、只作载波聚合的辅助载波，这里不计入可独立连网的频段。不含日本与中国移动网络；没有 2G。
modules.note_en: The maker also lists B32 (1500 MHz), receive-only and only as a secondary carrier in aggregation, so it is not counted as a band that can carry a connection alone. Excludes Japan and China Mobile; no 2G.

modules.name: Teltonika RUTX12 (1*****)
modules.text: LTE B2 B4 B5 B7 B12 B13 B25 B26 B30 B66
modules.note_zh: 官方还列有 B29（700 MHz），但只能接收、只作辅助载波，这里不计入。没有 B71（T-Mobile 600 MHz）；没有 2G。
modules.note_en: The maker also lists B29 (700 MHz), receive-only and only as a secondary carrier, so it is not counted. No B71 (T-Mobile 600 MHz); no 2G.

modules.name: Teltonika FMC130-ME3
modules.text: LTE B1 B3 B7 B8 B20 B28 B38 B40 B41
modules.note_zh: 基于 MeiG SLM320-E2 模组，LTE Cat 1，2G 回落；没有 3G。美洲请选 FMC130-MCIB0。
modules.note_en: Built on the MeiG SLM320-E2 module, LTE Cat 1 with 2G fallback; no 3G. For the Americas, choose the FMC130-MCIB0.

modules.name: Teltonika FMC130-MCIB0
modules.text: LTE B1 B2 B3 B4 B5 B7 B8 B20 B28 B40
modules.note_zh: 基于 MeiG SLM320-LA 模组，LTE Cat 1，2G 回落；没有 3G。没有 B12、B13、B66、B71，不适合美国。
modules.note_en: Built on the MeiG SLM320-LA module, LTE Cat 1 with 2G fallback; no 3G. No B12, B13, B66 or B71: not for the United States.

modules.name: Quectel EC25-AF
modules.text: LTE B2 B4 B5 B12 B13 B14 B66 B71
modules.note_zh: 北美通用版：Verizon、AT&T、T-Mobile、U.S. Cellular、Rogers、Telus；没有 B1、B3、B7、B20，不适合欧洲与亚洲。
modules.note_en: The North American version for Verizon, AT&T, T-Mobile, U.S. Cellular, Rogers and Telus; no B1, B3, B7 or B20, so not for Europe or Asia.

modules.name: Quectel EC25-EUX
modules.text: LTE B1 B3 B7 B8 B20 B28 B38 B40 B41
modules.note_zh: 与 EC25-E 相比多了 B28（官方写作 B28A，700 MHz 下半段），但没有 B5。
modules.note_en: Adds B28 over the EC25-E (listed as B28A, the lower half of 700 MHz) but has no B5.

modules.name: Quectel EC25-MX
modules.text: LTE B2 B4 B5 B7 B28 B66
modules.note_zh: 为墨西哥设计：有 Telcel 的 B4、B7、B66，也有 Altán 唯一使用的 B28。
modules.note_en: Designed for Mexico: B4, B7 and B66 for Telcel, and B28, the only band Altán uses.

modules.name: Quectel EC25-AU
modules.text: LTE B1 B2 B3 B4 B5 B7 B8 B28 B40
modules.note_zh: 官方注明 EC25-AU 的 B2 不支持接收分集，信号弱时性能会打折扣。没有 B20、B12、B13，不适合欧洲和美国。
modules.note_en: The maker notes that B2 on the EC25-AU has no receive diversity, so performance drops in weak signal. No B20, B12 or B13: not for Europe or the United States.

modules.name: Huawei E3372h-320
modules.text: LTE B1 B3 B7 B8 B20 B28
modules.note_zh: 以 GCF 认证记录为准：4G 为 B1、B3、B7、B8、B20、B28，不支持 TDD。部分销售页写的是没有 B28 的 E3372h-153 频段，购买时请核对后缀。
modules.note_en: Per its GCF certification record: LTE B1, B3, B7, B8, B20 and B28, no TDD. Some listings quote the bands of the E3372h-153 (without B28), so check the suffix when buying.

modules.name: USR IOT USR-G771-E
modules.text: LTE B1 B3 B7 B8 B20 B28
modules.note_zh: LTE Cat 1，覆盖欧洲主流运营商频段，带 2G 回落；没有 B5，不适合美洲。国内版 USR-G771 频段不同，请勿混用。
modules.note_en: LTE Cat 1 for the mainstream European bands, with 2G fallback; no B5, so not for the Americas. The Chinese USR-G771 has different bands; do not mix them up.

modules.name: USR IOT USR-DR154-E
modules.text: LTE B1 B3 B5 B7 B8 B20 B28
modules.note_zh: LTE Cat 1，体积小、可导轨安装；国内版 USR-DR154 只有 B1、B3、B5、B8，海外部署务必选 -E 版。
modules.note_en: LTE Cat 1, tiny and DIN-rail mountable; the Chinese USR-DR154 has only B1, B3, B5 and B8, so pick the -E version for deployments abroad.

modules.name: JACS TD191-B
modules.text: LTE B1 B2 B3 B4 B5 B7 B8 B12 B13 B17 B20 B66 B71 B39 B41 UMTS B1 B2 B4 B5 B8 GSM 850 900 1800 1900
modules.note_en: LTE Cat 4 USB dongle (Qualcomm MDM9x07), co-developed by Hyper Nexus, with the North American bands B2, B4, B5, B12, B13, B17, B66 and B71 (FCC ID 2AGCDJACSTD191-B).
modules.note_zh: LTE Cat 4 USB 上网卡（高通 MDM9x07），由 Hyper Nexus 参与开发，带北美的 B2、B4、B5、B12、B13、B17、B66、B71（FCC ID 2AGCDJACSTD191-B）。

changes.zh: 核心市场攻坚·收尾：Verizon 5G 独立组网（SA）由“推进中”更新为“已商用（2025 年起）”，依据 Verizon 新闻中心（网络切片运行于全国 5G SA 核心网）与 Fierce Network 报道。
changes.en: Core-market campaign, clean-up: Verizon’s 5G standalone (SA) status changes from “rolling out” to “live since 2025”, from Verizon’s News Center (network slicing on its nationwide 5G SA core) and Fierce Network.

changes.zh: 核心市场攻坚·收尾：撤下中国移动的 5G 频段 n8：唯一来源是本站国家指南所引的论坛帖子；中国移动 20-F 只记载 900 MHz 用于 GSM，工信部 900/800 MHz 重耕用于 5G 的批复分别给了中国联通与中国电信。如有官方依据将恢复。
changes.en: Core-market campaign, clean-up: China Mobile’s 5G band n8 is withdrawn: its only source was forum posts cited by our country guide; China Mobile’s 20-F records 900 MHz for GSM, and the MIIT’s approvals to refarm 900/800 MHz for 5G went to China Unicom and China Telecom. It will return if an official basis appears.

changes.zh: 核心市场攻坚·收尾：中国电信 2G/3G 保持“退网中”，去掉原先所附的 2020-06（那是云南开始关闭 3G 的时间，并非全国日期），改附 2025 年报道（原计划 2024 年底完成、尚未如期）；电信 B40 补上工信部 2013 年 TD-LTE 频率公布的报道（仍为 C 级）；中国国家页说明改写为依据运营商 20-F 与港交所法定披露核对。
changes.en: Core-market campaign, clean-up: China Telecom’s 2G/3G stay “switching off” without the earlier 2020-06 (the start of 3G closures in Yunnan, not a national date) and now cite a 2025 report (planned for end-2024, not yet complete); its B40 gains a report of the MIIT’s 2013 TD-LTE spectrum announcement (still C); China’s country-page note now says the bands are checked against the operators’ 20-F and HKEX filings.

changes.zh: 核心市场攻坚·收尾：Three 的 5G 独立组网（SA）仍为“随合并整合推进中”，来源更新为 VodafoneThree 合并问答与爱立信 2026-09-17 新闻稿（升级后的 5G 核心网上线）。
changes.en: Core-market campaign, clean-up: Three’s 5G standalone (SA) stays “being rolled out after the merger”, now sourced to VodafoneThree’s merger questions and Ericsson’s release of 17 September 2026 (the upgraded 5G Core goes live).

changes.zh: 核心市场攻坚·状态字段：中国电信 5G 独立组网（SA）状态改以电信 2020 年 20-F 为来源（“2020 年率先实现 5G SA 规模商用”），取代原先的 GSA 汇总。
changes.en: Core-market campaign, status fields: China Telecom’s 5G standalone (SA) status now rests on its 2020 Form 20-F (SA scale commercialisation pioneered in 2020) instead of the GSA summary.

changes.zh: 频段攻坚·第四十七批：依塞浦路斯电子通信司《宽带计划》（2016 年 800/2600 MHz 许可发给 Cyta、MTN）与欧盟委员会《2017 年欧洲数字进展报告》（每张许可含 800 MHz 2×10、2600 MHz FDD 2×20 与 TDD 1×15）：Cyta 与 Epic（原 MTN）的 B20、B7、B38 补上官方来源。
changes.en: Band campaign, batch forty-seven: From the Cyprus Department of Electronic Communications’ Broadband Plan (the 2016 800/2600 MHz licences went to Cyta and MTN) and the European Commission’s 2017 Digital Progress Report (each licence: 2×10 MHz at 800, 2×20 MHz FDD and 1×15 MHz TDD at 2600): the B20, B7 and B38 of Cyta and Epic (formerly MTN) gain official sources.

changes.zh: 频段攻坚·第四十五批：依 MTN 集团 2018-05-29 SENS 公告（2015 年中标 800 MHz 的 4G/LTE 牌照）：MTN 加纳的 B20 补上官方来源。
changes.en: Band campaign, batch forty-five: From MTN Group’s SENS announcement of 29 May 2018 (a 4G/LTE licence in the 800 MHz band won in 2015): MTN Ghana’s B20 gains an official source.

changes.zh: 频段攻坚·第四十五批：依 Safaricom 投资者推介（牌照含 800 MHz）：补登 Safaricom 埃塞俄比亚的 B20，暂标为未确认在用。
changes.en: Band campaign, batch forty-five: From Safaricom’s investor presentation (the licence includes 800 MHz): Safaricom Ethiopia’s B20 is added, marked as not yet confirmed in use.

changes.zh: 频段攻坚·第四十四批：依 Safaricom PLC H1 FY22 投资者推介（埃塞俄比亚牌照频谱位于 800、900、1800、2100、2600 MHz）：Safaricom 埃塞俄比亚的 B8、B3、B1、B7 补上官方来源，B20 同步补证。
changes.en: Band campaign, batch forty-four: From Safaricom PLC’s H1 FY22 investor presentation (Ethiopia licence spectrum in the 800, 900, 1,800, 2,100 and 2,600 MHz bands): Safaricom Ethiopia’s B8, B3, B1 and B7 gain an official source, and its B20 is corroborated.

changes.zh: 频段攻坚·第四十二批：依 Sonatel 向 BRVM 披露的 2016 年度业绩（取得 800 与 1800 MHz 的 4G 频率，期限 17 年）：Orange 塞内加尔的 B20、B3 补上官方来源。
changes.en: Band campaign, batch forty-two: From Sonatel’s 2016 annual results filed with the BRVM (4G frequencies in the 800 and 1800 MHz bands for 17 years): Orange Senegal’s B20 and B3 gain an official source.

changes.zh: 频段攻坚·第四十一批：依 UKE 公报刊载的 Polkomtel 意见书（2570–2620 MHz 预留续期至 2031 年）与 Polsat 集团 2020 年新闻稿（LTE 与 5G 均采用 TDD）：Plus 的 B38 补上官方来源，并确认在用。
changes.en: Band campaign, batch forty-one: From Polkomtel’s statement published in UKE’s bulletin (2570–2620 MHz reservation renewed to 2031) and the Polsat group’s 2020 press release (TDD used for both LTE and 5G): Plus’s B38 gains official sources and is confirmed in use.

changes.zh: 频段攻坚·第四十批：依 Orange 2025 年通用注册文件（博茨瓦纳 4G 牌照频谱位于 1800 MHz）：Orange 博茨瓦纳的 B3 补上官方来源。
changes.en: Band campaign, batch forty: From Orange’s 2025 Universal Registration Document (Botswana 4G licence spectrum in the 1,800 MHz band): Orange Botswana’s B3 gains an official source.

changes.zh: 频段攻坚·第三十九批：依 Viva-MTS 2020 年年报（1800 MHz 重整为 LTE）：Viva 的 B3 补上官方来源。
changes.en: Band campaign, batch thirty-nine: From Viva-MTS’s 2020 annual report (1800 MHz reframed to LTE): Viva’s B3 gains an official source.

changes.zh: 频段攻坚·第三十八批：依 Telenor 集团《频谱资源》（2026-02-05 更新）：Grameenphone 持有 2500 MHz 60 MHz（2022 年起）与 20 MHz（2025 年起），其 B41 补上官方来源。
changes.en: Band campaign, batch thirty-eight: From Telenor Group’s spectrum resources page (updated 5 February 2026): Grameenphone holds 60 MHz (since 2022) and 20 MHz (since 2025) at 2500 MHz, so its B41 gains an official source.

changes.zh: 频段攻坚·第三十八批（更正）撤回上一批对 DNA、Telia 芬兰 B1 的撤除：ECO 汇编缺少 DNA 的 2100 MHz 条目，Telia 的 UMTS 记载早于其 3G 关闭；依 Telenor 集团《频谱资源》，DNA 持有 2100 MHz 2×19.8（至 2033），其 B1 补上官方来源。
changes.en: Band campaign, batch thirty-eight (correction) The removal of DNA’s and Telia’s B1 in the previous batch is withdrawn: the ECO compilation lacks DNA’s 2100 MHz entry, and Telia’s UMTS entry predates its 3G switch-off; per Telenor Group’s spectrum page DNA holds 2100 MHz 2×19.8 (to 2033), so its B1 gains an official source.

changes.zh: 频段攻坚·第三十六批：依 INDOTEL 第 077-17 号决议（Altice 持有 850、900、1900、1700/1800 MHz，并获分配 1720–1730/2120–2130 MHz）：Altice 的 B5、B2、B4 补上官方来源，B8 同步补证。
changes.en: Band campaign, batch thirty-six: From INDOTEL Resolution 077-17 (Altice holds 850, 900, 1900 and 1700/1800 MHz and is assigned 1720–1730/2120–2130 MHz): Altice’s B5, B2 and B4 gain an official source, and its B8 is corroborated.

changes.zh: 频段攻坚·第三十五批：依 ASEP《IMT 频谱分配情况（2026 年 3 月）》：+Móvil 的 700 MHz（B28）补上官方来源，B2、B4 同步补证；Tigo 的 B28、B2 补证，并补登其 AWS（B4），暂标为未确认在用。
changes.en: Band campaign, batch thirty-five: From ASEP’s IMT spectrum register (March 2026): +Móvil’s 700 MHz (B28) gains an official source and its B2 and B4 are corroborated; Tigo’s B28 and B2 are corroborated and its AWS (B4) is added, marked as not yet confirmed in use.

changes.zh: 频段攻坚·第三十五批：依 ARCOTEL 2023 年频谱上限报告（1 GHz 以下 CNT 持有 30 MHz、AWS 已分配 80 MHz）：CNT 的 700 MHz（B28）与 AWS（B4）补上官方来源。
changes.en: Band campaign, batch thirty-five: From ARCOTEL’s 2023 spectrum-cap report (CNT holds 30 MHz below 1 GHz; 80 MHz of AWS assigned): CNT’s 700 MHz (B28) and AWS (B4) gain an official source.

changes.zh: 频段攻坚·第三十五批：依 Telecom Argentina 2003、2018 财年 20-F：Personal 的 1900 MHz（B2）补上官方来源，并补登 2018 年分配的 700 MHz（B28），暂标为未确认在用。
changes.en: Band campaign, batch thirty-five: From Telecom Argentina’s Forms 20-F for 2003 and 2018: Personal’s 1900 MHz (B2) gains an official source, and the 700 MHz assigned in 2018 (B28) is added, marked as not yet confirmed in use.

changes.zh: 频段攻坚·第三十五批：依 Millicom 2024 年 20-F（700 MHz 2×12 MHz）：Tigo 玻利维亚的 B12 补上官方来源。
changes.en: Band campaign, batch thirty-five: From Millicom’s 2024 Form 20-F (2×12 MHz at 700 MHz): Tigo Bolivia’s B12 gains an official source.

changes.zh: 频段攻坚·第三十四批：依台湾大哥大 2017 年度合并财报附注一（700、1800 MHz 自 2014 年起，2100 MHz 于 2017 年 11 月竞标取得）：B28、B3、B1 补上官方来源。
changes.en: Band campaign, batch thirty-four: From Note 1 of Taiwan Mobile’s 2017 consolidated financial statements (700 and 1800 MHz since 2014, 2100 MHz won in November 2017): its B28, B3 and B1 gain an official source.

changes.zh: 频段攻坚·第三十四批：依沃达丰 2026 年报频谱牌照总览：Vodacom 坦桑尼亚的 1800 MHz（B3）补上官方来源，补登 800 MHz（B20）与 2.6 GHz FDD（B7），暂标为未确认在用。
changes.en: Band campaign, batch thirty-four: From the spectrum-licence overview in Vodafone’s 2026 annual report: Vodacom Tanzania’s 1800 MHz (B3) gains an official source, and 800 MHz (B20) and 2.6 GHz FDD (B7) are added, marked as not yet confirmed in use.

changes.zh: 频段攻坚·第三十四批：依沃达丰 2026 年报频谱牌照总览：Vodacom 刚果（金）的 800 MHz（B20）补上官方来源，补登 700 MHz（B28），暂标为未确认在用。
changes.en: Band campaign, batch thirty-four: From the spectrum-licence overview in Vodafone’s 2026 annual report: Vodacom DRC’s 800 MHz (B20) gains an official source, and 700 MHz (B28) is added, marked as not yet confirmed in use.

changes.zh: 频段攻坚·第三十四批：依沃达丰 2026 年报频谱牌照总览：Vodacom 莫桑比克的 800 MHz（B20）补上官方来源。
changes.en: Band campaign, batch thirty-four: From the spectrum-licence overview in Vodafone’s 2026 annual report: Vodacom Mozambique’s 800 MHz (B20) gains an official source.

changes.zh: 频段攻坚·第三十四批：依沃达丰 2026 年报频谱牌照总览：Vodacom 莱索托的 1800 MHz（B3）与 800 MHz（B20）补上官方来源。
changes.en: Band campaign, batch thirty-four: From the spectrum-licence overview in Vodafone’s 2026 annual report: Vodacom Lesotho’s 1800 MHz (B3) and 800 MHz (B20) gain an official source.

changes.zh: 频段攻坚·第三十三批：依 Zain 沙特 2019 年官网新闻稿（频谱组合含 800 MHz）：Zain 的 B20 补上官方来源；依 CITC 2017 年拍卖公告及 STC 的证交所申报：STC 的 700 MHz（B28）补上官方来源。
changes.en: Band campaign, batch thirty-three: From Zain KSA’s 2019 release (its spectrum roster includes 800 MHz): Zain’s B20 gains an official source; from CITC’s 2017 auction announcement and STC’s bourse filing: STC’s 700 MHz (B28) gains an official source.

changes.zh: 频段攻坚·第三十三批：依 UCC 2023 年频谱授予结果：MTN 乌干达补登 700 MHz（B28）与 2300 MHz TDD（B40），暂标为未确认在用。
changes.en: Band campaign, batch thirty-three: From UCC’s 2023 spectrum award: MTN Uganda adds 700 MHz (B28) and 2300 MHz TDD (B40), marked as not yet confirmed in use.

changes.zh: 频段攻坚·第三十二批（补全）：依 ICASA 2022 年拍卖结果：Vodacom、Rain 补登 700 MHz（B28），MTN、Telkom 补登 800 MHz（B20）；依 ICASA 2013 年频谱使用报告补登 Vodacom 的 900 MHz（B8）。新补频段暂标为未确认在用。
changes.en: Band campaign, batch thirty-two (completeness): From ICASA’s 2022 auction results: Vodacom and Rain add 700 MHz (B28), and MTN and Telkom add 800 MHz (B20); from ICASA’s 2013 spectrum-usage report, Vodacom adds 900 MHz (B8). The new bands are marked as not yet confirmed in use.

changes.zh: 频段攻坚·第三十一批：依沃达丰 2026 年报频谱牌照总览脚注 10：Vodacom 莫桑比克已取得 2×5 MHz 的 1800 MHz（到期 2039 年），其 B3 补上官方来源。
changes.en: Band campaign, batch thirty-one: From note 10 of the spectrum-licence overview in Vodafone’s 2026 annual report: Vodacom Mozambique has acquired 2×5 MHz of 1800 MHz (expiring 2039); its B3 gains an official source.

changes.zh: 频段攻坚·第三十一批（含更正）Millicom 已于 2026 年 4 月全资持有 Coltel（Movistar 哥伦比亚）并与 Tigo 统一运营；Tigo 的 B5 即原 Coltel 的 850 MHz（Telefónica 2024 年 20-F：25 MHz），补上官方来源，不再视为伙伴网络频段。
changes.en: Band campaign, batch thirty-one (with a correction) Millicom has owned all of Coltel (Movistar Colombia) since April 2026 and runs it together with Tigo; Tigo’s B5 is Coltel’s former 850 MHz (25 MHz in Telefónica’s 2024 Form 20-F), gains an official source and is no longer treated as a partner-network band.

changes.zh: 频段攻坚·第三十一批（更正）Digi 的 B20（800 MHz）与 B38（TDD 2600 MHz）在 2012、2022 年拍卖结果、2014 年 ECO 汇编及 2025 年 TKRM 转让中均无持有依据，予以撤除。
changes.en: Band campaign, batch thirty-one (correction) Digi’s B20 (800 MHz) and B38 (2600 MHz TDD) are not supported by the 2012 or 2022 auction results, the 2014 ECO compilation or the 2025 TKRM transfer, and are removed.

changes.zh: 频段攻坚·第三十一批（更正）Ofcom 2024 年分配表中 EE 名下没有 2.6 GHz TDD 频段，撤除 EE 的 B38。
changes.en: Band campaign, batch thirty-one (correction) Ofcom’s 2024 allocation lists no 2.6 GHz TDD spectrum for EE, so EE’s B38 is removed.

changes.zh: 频段攻坚·第三十一批（更正）以色列通信部 2020 年 5G 招标只涉及 700、2600、3500 MHz，找不到 Partner、HOT 持有 1500 MHz 的依据，撤除两家的 B32。
changes.en: Band campaign, batch thirty-one (correction) Israel’s 2020 5G tender covered only 700, 2600 and 3500 MHz, and nothing shows Partner or HOT holding 1500 MHz, so both B32 records are removed.

changes.zh: 频段攻坚·第三十批：依 Komdigi 2026 年 7 月第 06 号公告：Telkomsel、Indosat、XLSMART 在 2026 年拍得的 700 MHz（B28）补上官方来源。
changes.en: Band campaign, batch thirty: From Komdigi announcement No. 06 of July 2026: the 700 MHz (B28) won in 2026 by Telkomsel, Indosat and XLSMART gains an official source.

changes.zh: 频段攻坚·第三十批：依 ILR 2026-05-27《现行频率使用权清单》：Orange 的 700 MHz（B28）补上官方来源，B20、B7 同步补证。
changes.en: Band campaign, batch thirty: From ILR’s register of existing rights of use (27 May 2026): Orange’s 700 MHz (B28) gains an official source, and its B20 and B7 are corroborated.

changes.zh: 频段攻坚·第二十九批：依 Verizon 2025 年 10-K：蜂窝频段 850 MHz（B5）与 PCS 1900 MHz（B2）补上官方来源。
changes.en: Band campaign, batch twenty-nine: From Verizon’s 2025 Form 10-K: its Cellular 850 MHz (B5) and PCS 1900 MHz (B2) gain an official source.

changes.zh: 频段攻坚·第二十九批：依印度政府新闻局 2023-06-07 公告：BSNL 的 700 MHz（B28）补上官方来源。
changes.en: Band campaign, batch twenty-nine: From the Press Information Bureau release of 7 June 2023: BSNL’s 700 MHz (B28) gains an official source.

changes.zh: 频段攻坚·第二十九批：依 ANCOM 2025-10-08 新闻稿：Digi 新增从 TKRM 转来的 1800 MHz（B3），其 B8、B1、B7 补上官方来源。
changes.en: Band campaign, batch twenty-nine: From ANCOM’s press release of 8 October 2025: Digi adds the 1800 MHz (B3) transferred from Telekom Romania Mobile, and its B8, B1 and B7 gain an official source.

changes.zh: 频段攻坚·第二十九批：依《数位时代》与科技新报报道：台湾大哥大的 B28、B3、B1 补登媒体来源，官方原件待补。
changes.en: Band campaign, batch twenty-nine: From reports by Business Next and TechNews: Taiwan Mobile’s B28, B3 and B1 gain media sources; the official original is still pending.

changes.zh: 频段攻坚·第二十五至二十八批：依 Telefónica 2024 年 20-F 附录六、美洲电信 2024 年 20-F 与 Entel 2024 年综合年报：Movistar 的 B28、B4，Claro 的 B2，Entel 的 B28、B2、B4 补上官方来源。
changes.en: Band campaign, batches twenty-five to twenty-eight: From Telefónica’s 2024 Form 20-F (Appendix VI), América Móvil’s 2024 Form 20-F and Entel’s 2024 integrated report: Movistar’s B28 and B4, Claro’s B2 and Entel’s B28, B2 and B4 gain an official source.

changes.zh: 频段攻坚·第二十五至二十八批：依 Telefónica 2024 年 20-F 附录六：Movistar 委内瑞拉的 B2、B4、B7 补上官方来源。
changes.en: Band campaign, batches twenty-five to twenty-eight: From Telefónica’s 2024 Form 20-F (Appendix VI): Movistar Venezuela’s B2, B4 and B7 gain an official source.

changes.zh: 频段攻坚·第二十五至二十八批：依 Telefónica 与美洲电信 2024 年 20-F：Movistar 的 B2、Claro 的 B4 补上官方来源。
changes.en: Band campaign, batches twenty-five to twenty-eight: From the 2024 Forms 20-F of Telefónica and América Móvil: Movistar’s B2 and Claro’s B4 gain an official source.

changes.zh: 频段攻坚·第二十五至二十八批：依 Telefónica 与美洲电信 2024 年 20-F：Movistar 的 B28、B2，Claro 的 B28 补上官方来源。
changes.en: Band campaign, batches twenty-five to twenty-eight: From the 2024 Forms 20-F of Telefónica and América Móvil: Movistar’s B28 and B2 and Claro’s B28 gain an official source.

changes.zh: 频段攻坚·第二十五至二十八批：依 Telefónica 与美洲电信 2024 年 20-F：Movistar、Claro 的 1900 MHz（B2）补上官方来源。
changes.en: Band campaign, batches twenty-five to twenty-eight: From the 2024 Forms 20-F of Telefónica and América Móvil: the 1900 MHz (B2) of Movistar and Claro gains an official source.

changes.zh: 频段攻坚·第二十五至二十八批：依美洲电信 2024 年 20-F：Claro 巴拉圭的 B28、B4 补上官方来源。
changes.en: Band campaign, batches twenty-five to twenty-eight: From América Móvil’s 2024 Form 20-F: Claro Paraguay’s B28 and B4 gain an official source.

changes.zh: 频段攻坚·第二十五至二十八批：依美洲电信 2024 年 20-F 与智利最高法院第 181-2020 号判决：Claro 智利（含 VTR）的 B4 补上官方来源。
changes.en: Band campaign, batches twenty-five to twenty-eight: From América Móvil’s 2024 Form 20-F and Chilean Supreme Court ruling 181-2020: Claro Chile’s B4 (VTR’s AWS) gains an official source.

changes.zh: 频段攻坚·第二十五至二十八批：依 Millicom 2024 年 20-F 频谱持有表：Tigo 玻利维亚的 B4 补上官方来源。
changes.en: Band campaign, batches twenty-five to twenty-eight: From Millicom’s 2024 Form 20-F spectrum table: Tigo Bolivia’s B4 gains an official source.

changes.zh: 频段攻坚·第二十五至二十八批：依 Dialog 2025 年年报：补登其 2025 年 12 月取得的 5G 频段 n78（3400–3500 MHz）与 n258（27200–27400 MHz）。
changes.en: Band campaign, batches twenty-five to twenty-eight: From Dialog’s 2025 annual report: adds the 5G bands it secured in December 2025, n78 (3400–3500 MHz) and n258 (27200–27400 MHz).

changes.zh: 频段攻坚·A/B 级第二十四批：依 APT REP-15 第 11 版柬埔寨答复（数据截至 2010 年 1 月，附牌照有效期），Metfone、Cellcard、Smart 的 1800 MHz（B3）与 Smart 的 2100 MHz（B1，原 TMIC 频段）补上官方来源。
changes.en: Band campaign, grade A/B batch twenty-four: from Cambodia’s response in APT REP-15 Rev.11 (data as of January 2010, with licence terms), the 1800 MHz (B3) of Metfone, Cellcard and Smart and Smart’s 2100 MHz (B1, formerly TMIC’s) gain an official source.

changes.zh: 频段攻坚·A/B 级第二十三批：依 OSIPTEL 第 00323-GAL/2018 号报告（数据出自 MTC 国家频率登记册），秘鲁 Movistar 的 1900 MHz（B2）与 Entel 的 2.3 GHz（B40）补上官方来源。
changes.en: Band campaign, grade A/B batch twenty-three: from OSIPTEL report 00323-GAL/2018 (figures from the MTC’s National Frequency Register), Movistar Peru’s 1900 MHz (B2) and Entel Peru’s 2.3 GHz (B40) gain an official source.

changes.zh: 频段攻坚·第二十二批（含更正）：依澳门邮电局《营运商的流动电信网络所使用之频率》（2026-02-13），澳门电讯的 B1、B8，中国电信（澳门）的 B1、B5，和记的 B8 补上官方来源并确认在用；三家的 B7、澳门电讯的 B40、和记的 B1 不在现行频率表内，予以撤除；澳门电讯与中国电信补登 5G 的 n1、n78、n79。
changes.en: Band campaign, batch twenty-two (with corrections): from CTT’s table of the frequencies in use (13 Feb 2026), CTM’s B1 and B8, China Telecom (Macau)’s B1 and B5 and Hutchison’s B8 gain an official source and are confirmed in use; all three operators’ B7, CTM’s B40 and Hutchison’s B1 are not in the current table and are removed; CTM and China Telecom gain 5G n1, n78 and n79.

changes.zh: 频段攻坚·A/B 级第二十一批：Rogers 的 B5 依其 2025 年年报的频谱持有表（850 MHz 全加拿大 25 MHz）补上官方来源；Bell 的 B5、B71 依 BCE《2025 年度信息表》（已部署 850 MHz 与 600 MHz）补上官方来源。
changes.en: Band campaign, grade A/B batch twenty-one: Rogers’ B5 gains its 2025 annual report’s spectrum table (25 MHz of 850 MHz across Canada); Bell’s B5 and B71 gain BCE’s 2025 Annual Information Form (850 MHz and 600 MHz deployed).

changes.zh: 频段攻坚·A/B 级第二十批：哥伦比亚 Claro 的 B5（850 MHz）依 MinTIC 2019 年拍卖听证会的逐家频谱图表补上官方来源（同一图表此前已用于各家的 B2）。
changes.en: Band campaign, grade A/B batch twenty: Claro Colombia’s B5 (850 MHz) gains the per-operator spectrum chart from MinTIC’s 2019 auction hearing as an official source (the same chart already supports each operator’s B2).

changes.zh: 频段攻坚·A/B 级第十七至十九批：远传的 B28、B3、B7、B1 依其官网公司简介补上官方来源；多米尼加 Claro 的 B4 依 INDOTEL 第 070-17 号决议补上；沙特 Mobily 的 B20 依其投资者推介补上；评级规则统一——运营商自编的 GSMA IR.21 文件即使存于第三方网站亦按官方原件计，Vodafone Oman 的 B3、B28、B1、B8 因此升级。
changes.en: Band campaign, grade A/B batches seventeen to nineteen: FET’s B28, B3, B7 and B1 gain its corporate company introduction as an official source; Claro Dominicana’s B4 gains INDOTEL Resolution 070-17; Mobily’s B20 gains its investor presentation; grading rule made consistent — an operator-authored GSMA IR.21 counts as an official original even when the copy is hosted elsewhere, lifting Vodafone Oman’s B3, B28, B1 and B8.

changes.zh: 更正：埃及 e&（Etisalat）的 2.6 GHz 原登记为 B7（FDD），改为 B41（TDD）。NTRA 公告写明 2020 年 2600 MHz 授予全部采用 TDD，同批中标的 Vodafone、WE 亦为 B41；原 B7 所依据的正是这几篇 TDD 拍卖报道。
changes.en: Correction: e& (Etisalat) Egypt’s 2.6 GHz, recorded as B7 (FDD), is now B41 (TDD). NTRA’s announcement shows the 2020 2600 MHz award was entirely TDD, and Vodafone and WE from the same award are B41; the B7 record rested on reports of that same TDD award.

changes.zh: 频段攻坚·A/B 级第十六批：埃及 Vodafone 的 B3、B41 依 Vodafone 集团频谱持有表与 NTRA 公告补上官方来源，WE 的 B41 依 NTRA 公告补上；马尔代夫 Dhiraagu 的 B3、B7 依其 LTE-A 新闻稿补上；肯尼亚 Safaricom 的 B3、B1 依其 2024 年年报所列频段补上。
changes.en: Band campaign, grade A/B batch sixteen: Vodafone Egypt’s B3 and B41 gain the Vodafone Group spectrum table and NTRA’s announcement as official sources, and WE’s B41 the NTRA announcement; Dhiraagu’s B3 and B7 in the Maldives gain its LTE-Advanced press release; Safaricom’s B3 and B1 in Kenya gain the bands listed in its 2024 annual report.

changes.zh: 频段攻坚·A/B 级第十五批：哥伦比亚 Claro、Tigo、WOM 的 B28 与 WOM 的 B7 依 MinTIC 2019 年拍卖结果公告及发证决议补上官方来源；罗马尼亚四家的 B1 依 ANCOM 2100 MHz 牌照新闻稿补上。
changes.en: Band campaign, grade A/B batch fifteen: B28 of Claro, Tigo and WOM in Colombia and WOM’s B7 gain MinTIC’s 2019 auction results and assignment resolutions as an official source; B1 of Romania’s four networks gains ANCOM’s press release on the 2100 MHz licences.

changes.zh: 频段攻坚·A/B 级第十四批：阿曼 Ooredoo 的 B3、B40 依其受 TRA 监管的国内漫游参考报价附件补上官方来源（附件逐项列出 GSM 900/1800 与 800、2100、2300、2600 MHz）。
changes.en: Band campaign, grade A/B batch fourteen: Ooredoo Oman’s B3 and B40 gain the national roaming annex of its TRA-regulated reference offer as an official source (the annex lists GSM 900/1800 and 800, 2100, 2300 and 2600 MHz).

changes.zh: 频段攻坚·A/B 级第十三批：哈萨克斯坦 Beeline 的 B1、B3、B20 依 VEON 的 20-F 年报补上官方来源，Kcell 的 B3、B20 依其 2016 年证交所公告与 2019 年年报补上；孟加拉 Banglalink 的 B40 依 VEON 20-F 年报（2022 年取得 2.3 GHz 40 MHz）补上。
changes.en: Band campaign, grade A/B batch thirteen: B1, B3 and B20 of Beeline Kazakhstan gain VEON’s Form 20-F annual reports as an official source, and Kcell’s B3 and B20 its 2016 stock-exchange announcement and 2019 annual report; Banglalink’s B40 in Bangladesh gains VEON’s 20-F (40 MHz at 2.3 GHz acquired in 2022).

changes.zh: 频段攻坚·A/B 级第十二批：台湾中华电信的 B1、B3、B7、B8 依其向美国证交会提交的 20-F 年报补上官方来源（900/1800 MHz 于 2013 年、2500/2600 MHz 于 2015 年、1800/2100 MHz 于 2017 年取得，2022 年另购得亚太电信 900 MHz）。
changes.en: Band campaign, grade A/B batch twelve: B1, B3, B7 and B8 of Chunghwa Telecom in Taiwan gain its Form 20-F annual reports filed with the US SEC as an official source (900/1800 MHz obtained in 2013, 2500/2600 MHz in 2015, 1800/2100 MHz in 2017, plus Asia Pacific Telecom’s 900 MHz bought in 2022).

changes.zh: 频段攻坚·A/B 级第十一批：智利依最高法院判决所引 SUBTEL 频谱分配表补上 Entel、Movistar、Claro 的 B2，Claro 的 B5，WOM 的 B4、B66；乌拉圭 Antel 的 B28 依 URSEC 决议与第 155/017 号法令补上；阿根廷三家的 B7 依 ENACOM 决议（官方公报 2022）补上。
changes.en: Band campaign, grade A/B batch eleven: in Chile, B2 of Entel, Movistar and Claro, Claro’s B5 and WOM’s B4 and B66 gain the SUBTEL spectrum table reproduced in a Supreme Court judgment; Antel’s B28 in Uruguay gains a URSEC resolution and Decree 155/017; B7 of Argentina’s three networks gains an ENACOM resolution (Official Gazette, 2022).

changes.zh: 加拿大 Vidéotron、Freedom 补登 B13：两家的 700 MHz 是 2014 年拍卖中的 C1 块，按 ISED 频段规划属上 700 MHz（746–751/777–782 MHz），即 B13，此前漏登；两家的 B7 依 ISED 2500 MHz 拍卖结果补上官方来源（Freedom 的频谱于 2017 年经 ISED 批准从 Vidéotron 转让）。
changes.en: Canada: B13 added for Vidéotron and Freedom — their 700 MHz is block C1 from the 2014 auction, which ISED’s band plan places in the upper 700 MHz (746–751/777–782 MHz), i.e. band 13, missing until now; their B7 gains ISED’s 2500 MHz auction results as an official source (Freedom’s spectrum was transferred from Vidéotron with ISED approval in 2017).

changes.zh: 频段攻坚·A/B 级第十批：塞尔维亚三家依 RATEL 年度报告补上 B1、B3、B8、B20 官方来源；瑞典 Tele2、Telenor、Tre 依 PTS 2023 年发牌决定补上 B7、B8、B38；罗马尼亚 Orange 的 B28、B32 与 Digi 的 B7 依 ANCOM 2022 年拍卖结果补上。
changes.en: Band campaign, grade A/B batch ten: Serbia’s three networks gain RATEL’s annual report for B1, B3, B8 and B20; Tele2, Telenor and Tre in Sweden gain PTS’s 2023 licence decision for B7, B8 and B38; Orange Romania’s B28 and B32 and Digi’s B7 gain ANCOM’s 2022 auction results.

changes.zh: 频段攻坚·A/B 级第九批：肯尼亚三家的 B20 与 Faiba 的 B28 依通信管理局社区网络框架（2021）补上官方来源；坦桑尼亚 Vodacom 的 B40、Airtel 的 B7 依 TCRA 2022 年拍卖结果公告补上；留尼汪 Orange 的 B20 依 ECO Report 03 补上。
changes.en: Band campaign, grade A/B batch nine: B20 of Kenya’s three networks and B28 of Faiba gain the Communications Authority’s community networks framework (2021) as an official source; Vodacom Tanzania’s B40 and Airtel Tanzania’s B7 gain TCRA’s 2022 auction results notice; Orange Réunion’s B20 gains ECO Report 03.

changes.zh: 频段攻坚·A/B 级第八批：科特迪瓦三家（Orange、MTN、Moov）依 ARTCI《频率管理战略》咨询文件（2018）补上官方来源——三家于 2016 年 12 月获发数量相同、在相同频段平均分配的频谱，800 MHz 与 2600 MHz FDD 专供移动牌照持有者。
changes.en: Band campaign, grade A/B batch eight: Côte d’Ivoire’s three networks (Orange, MTN, Moov) gain ARTCI’s frequency strategy consultation (2018) as an official source — each received in December 2016 the same amount of spectrum spread equally across the same bands, and the 800 MHz and 2600 MHz FDD bands are reserved for mobile licence holders.

changes.zh: 频段攻坚·A/B 级第七批：俄罗斯四家（MTS、MegaFon、Beeline、T2）的 B3、B7、B8、B20 及 MTS、MegaFon 的 B38，依俄罗斯通信部关于国家无线电频率委员会 LTE 频段共用决定的新闻稿（2015）补上官方来源，并以 2021 年四家 LTE 频率许可延长十年的报道佐证。
changes.en: Band campaign, grade A/B batch seven: B3, B7, B8 and B20 of Russia’s four networks (MTS, MegaFon, Beeline, T2), and B38 of MTS and MegaFon, gain the Russian telecom ministry’s release on the radio frequency commission’s LTE spectrum-sharing decision (2015) as an official source, supported by reports of the four operators’ LTE permissions being extended for ten years in 2021.

changes.zh: ★ 频段攻坚·A/B 级第六批（APT REP-15 第 11 版，2026-04）：补登老挝第三张网络 ETL；老挝、澳大利亚补登主管部门写明 LTE 在用的频段（Lao Telecom B1/B7/B8/B40，Unitel B40，Optus B5/B8，TPG B28）；泰国 AIS 的 B28 等确认在用；⚠ 依主管部门清单移出：中国电信 B40、Viettel B7、2degrees B7、Nepal Telecom B20、印尼三家的 B41。卡塔尔两家的 2.6 GHz TDD（B38、B41）依 CRA 2024 年决定补上官方来源（2025 年 3 月 31 日起该频段只用 TDD）。
changes.en: ★ Band campaign, grade A/B batch six (APT REP-15 Rev.11, April 2026): Laos’s third network, ETL, is added; bands stated by the administration as LTE in use are added in Laos and Australia (Lao Telecom B1/B7/B8/B40, Unitel B40, Optus B5/B8, TPG B28); AIS Thailand’s B28 and more are confirmed; ⚠ removed because they are absent from the administration’s list: China Telecom B40, Viettel B7, 2degrees B7, Nepal Telecom B20 and B41 for Indonesia’s three networks. Qatar’s 2.6 GHz TDD (B38, B41) for both networks gains the CRA’s 2024 decision as an official source (the band is TDD-only from 31 March 2025).

changes.zh: 频段攻坚·A/B 级第五批：特立尼达和多巴哥 Digicel 与 TSTT（bmobile）的 B2、B4、B28 依 TATT《公众移动通信频谱规划》第 4.2 版（2024）补上官方来源；巴林各运营商的 800、2600 MHz 频段依 TRA 官方新闻稿（2019）补上官方来源；卡塔尔 Ooredoo、Vodafone 的 2.6 GHz TDD（B38/B41）依 CRA 2024 年决定（2025 年 3 月 31 日前全部改用 TDD）补上官方来源。
changes.en: Band campaign, grade A/B batch five: Digicel and TSTT (bmobile) Trinidad and Tobago gain official sources for B2, B4 and B28 from TATT’s Spectrum Plan for Public Mobile Telecommunications Services v4.2 (2024); Bahrain’s 800 and 2600 MHz bands gain TRA’s own 2019 press release as an official source; Ooredoo and Vodafone Qatar’s 2.6 GHz TDD (B38/B41) gain CRA’s 2024 decision (all of the band TDD by 31 March 2025).

changes.zh: ★ 频段攻坚·A/B 级第四批（亚太 14 国）：引入 APT 报告 REP-15《亚太各国移动运营商的频率、技术与许可期限》（各国主管部门逐运营商填报），为中国、缅甸、孟加拉、新西兰、新加坡、尼泊尔、泰国、蒙古、印尼、澳大利亚、越南、文莱、巴布亚新几内亚、菲律宾的约 55 条记录补上官方来源；写明 LTE 在用且填报于 2016 年以后的 13 条确认在用（中国电信 B1/B3、中国联通 B1/B8、One NZ B1/B7、Spark B40、新加坡三家的 2600 TDD 等）。2015 年以前的填报只挂来源，不作确认依据。
changes.en: ★ Band campaign, grade A/B batch four (14 Asia-Pacific countries): APT Report REP-15, “Information of mobile operators’ frequencies, technologies and licence durations in Asia Pacific countries” (each administration lists every operator’s blocks), now backs about 55 records in China, Myanmar, Bangladesh, New Zealand, Singapore, Nepal, Thailand, Mongolia, Indonesia, Australia, Viet Nam, Brunei, PNG and the Philippines; 13 records where LTE is stated in use in entries from 2016 on are confirmed (China Telecom B1/B3, China Unicom B1/B8, One NZ B1/B7, Spark B40, 2.6 GHz TDD for Singapore’s three networks and more). Entries older than 2016 only add sources.

changes.zh: ★ 频段攻坚·A/B 级第三批（核心市场）：尼日利亚五家运营商依 NCC 官方频率分配表（700、800、900、1800、2600 MHz）补上官方来源 8 条；⚠ 依同一官方表，Globacom 在 2.6 GHz 只有 TDD 段（2575–2615 MHz），移出其 B7。阿曼 Omantel、Ooredoo 的 B20、B7 依 TRA 年报（授予 800、2600 MHz 的 LTE 使用权）补上官方来源。
changes.en: ★ Band campaign, grade A/B batch three (core markets): Nigeria’s five operators gain 8 official sources from NCC’s frequency assignment tables (700, 800, 900, 1800 and 2600 MHz); ⚠ the same table gives Globacom only the TDD block at 2.6 GHz (2575–2615 MHz), so its B7 is removed. Omantel and Ooredoo Oman gain official sources for B20 and B7 from TRA’s annual report (LTE rights at 800 and 2600 MHz).

changes.zh: ★ 频段攻坚·A/B 级第二批（欧洲 15 国，依据完整版 ECO Report 03）：为立陶宛、拉脱维亚、斯洛伐克、乌克兰、瑞典、挪威、罗马尼亚、塞尔维亚、黑山、卢森堡、摩尔多瓦、摩纳哥、土耳其、英国、安道尔的 38 张网络补上官方使用权来源（137 条）；“在用技术”写明 LTE/4G 的确认在用；补登立陶宛 Bite、Tele2 的 B1 与 B8，斯洛伐克 O2、Orange 的 B1，安道尔的 B1（均写明 LTE 在用）；⚠ 乌克兰 lifecell 无 900 MHz 使用权，移出其 B8。罗马尼亚（2014 年填报）、塞尔维亚（2017 年）只挂来源、不据此删减。另：巴基斯坦 Jazz 依 VEON 官方新闻稿（2026-03-10 拍卖拍得 700、2300、2600 MHz）挂上 B28、B40、B41 的官方来源；加拿大 Rogers、Telus 补挂 3 条官方来源。
changes.en: ★ Band campaign, grade A/B batch two (15 European countries, from the full ECO Report 03): 38 networks in Lithuania, Latvia, Slovakia, Ukraine, Sweden, Norway, Romania, Serbia, Montenegro, Luxembourg, Moldova, Monaco, Türkiye, the UK and Andorra gain official rights-of-use sources (137 records); records stated as LTE/4G in use are confirmed; LTE bands in use but missing are added (B1 and B8 for Bite and Tele2 Lithuania, B1 for O2 and Orange Slovakia, B1 for Andorra); ⚠ lifecell Ukraine holds no 900 MHz, so its B8 is removed. Romania (2014 entries) and Serbia (2017) only add sources, nothing is removed on their account. Also: Jazz Pakistan’s B28, B40 and B41 are backed by VEON’s own release on the 10 March 2026 auction; Rogers and Telus Canada gain three official sources.

changes.zh: ★ 频段攻坚·A/B 级第一批（欧洲 13 国）：引入 CEPT 欧洲通信办公室 ECO Report 03（各国主管部门在 EFIS 填报的移动频段使用权，2026-08-24 生成，A 级），为奥地利、比利时、保加利亚、捷克、丹麦、爱沙尼亚、芬兰、格鲁吉亚、希腊、匈牙利、冰岛、克罗地亚、阿尔巴尼亚的频段记录补上官方持有来源；“在用技术”写明 LTE 的 17 条确认在用（冰岛、希腊 2600 TDD、格鲁吉亚、阿尔巴尼亚、芬兰 900 MHz 等），补登 7 条在用而漏登的频段；⚠ 移出 5 条官方使用权清单中不存在的频段：奥地利 Drei 的 B20、爱沙尼亚 Telia 的 B38、格鲁吉亚 Silknet 与 Cellfie 的 B7、希腊 Nova 的 B1。
changes.en: ★ Band campaign, grade A/B batch one (13 European countries): ECO Report 03 from the CEPT European Communications Office (rights of use entered in EFIS by each administration, generated 24 August 2026, grade A) now backs band records in Austria, Belgium, Bulgaria, the Czech Republic, Denmark, Estonia, Finland, Georgia, Greece, Hungary, Iceland, Croatia and Albania; 17 records are confirmed in use where it states LTE (Iceland, 2.6 GHz TDD in Greece, Georgia, Albania, 900 MHz in Finland and more) and 7 missing bands in use are added; ⚠ 5 bands absent from the official lists are removed: Drei Austria B20, Telia Estonia B38, Silknet and Cellfie Georgia B7, Nova Greece B1.

changes.zh: ★ 频段攻坚·斯洛文尼亚整国核实（监管机构 AKOS 按运营商、按频段公布的在用 LTE 小区数，A 级）：补登遗漏的第四张网络 T-2（LTE 2100、2300 MHz，覆盖 56.54% 人口）；Telekom Slovenije 与 Telemach 补登并确认 B28（700 MHz，分别在用 919、1,703 个小区），Telemach 另补 B40（2300 MHz）；A1 的 B1 确认（1,350 个小区）；⚠ 移出 A1 的 B8（AKOS 自 2024 年起无 LTE 900 小区）及 A1、Telekom Slovenije 的 B38（无 2600 MHz TDD 的 LTE 小区）。
changes.en: ★ Band campaign, Slovenia checked in full (AKOS, the regulator, publishes LTE cells in use by operator and band; grade A): T-2, the fourth network, is added (LTE on 2100 and 2300 MHz, 56.54% of the population); Telekom Slovenije and Telemach gain B28 (700 MHz; 919 and 1,703 cells), Telemach also B40 (2300 MHz); A1’s B1 is confirmed (1,350 cells); ⚠ A1’s B8 is removed (no LTE 900 cells since 2024), as is B38 for A1 and Telekom Slovenije (no LTE cells in 2600 MHz TDD).

changes.zh: 尼日利亚 T2（原 9mobile）：据 MTN 尼日利亚致交易所公告，T2 自 2025 年 10 月 1 日起把 1800 MHz 的 15 MHz 与 900 MHz 的 5 MHz 租给 MTN 三年，T2 用户经全国漫游使用 MTN 网络；T2 自有的 B3（2016 年起用于 4G）仍登记为“待确认”，选型以 MTN 的频段为准。
changes.en: Nigeria, T2 (formerly 9mobile): according to MTN Nigeria’s notice to the exchange, T2 has leased 15 MHz at 1800 MHz and 5 MHz at 900 MHz to MTN for three years from 1 October 2025, and T2 customers roam nationally on MTN; T2’s own B3 (used for 4G since 2016) stays unconfirmed, so choose modules by MTN’s bands.

changes.zh: ★ 工作线 C·补完单网络国家：塞舌尔新增 Cable & Wireless（ITU 国别报告：2015 年以 800/1800 MHz 开通 LTE，B20、B3 确认），并确认 Airtel 塞舌尔的 B20、补登并确认 B3；所罗门群岛新增 bmobile（2019 年由 Bmobile-Vodafone 更名），Our Telekom 的 B3 由其官网原文确认；科摩罗新增 Huri（Comores Télécom）；汤加新增 U-Call（TCC）；几内亚新增 Areeba（原 MTN 几内亚，据 Selectra 于 2025 年 12 月国有化）与 Cellcom；多哥新增 Moov Africa。除注明确认者外，新网络频段均为“待确认”。⚠ 多哥 Moov 的 B66 来自两份众包清单，B66 下行与 2100 MHz（B1）重叠，可能是 B1 被误判，待核。
changes.en: ★ Work line C, the last single-network countries: Seychelles gains Cable & Wireless (ITU profile: LTE in 2015 on 800/1800 MHz, B20 and B3 confirmed), and Airtel Seychelles gets B20 confirmed and B3 added and confirmed; Solomon Islands gains bmobile (renamed from Bmobile-Vodafone in 2019), and Our Telekom’s B3 is confirmed by its own site; Comoros gains Huri (Comores Télécom); Tonga gains U-Call (TCC); Guinea gains Areeba (formerly MTN Guinée, nationalised in December 2025 according to Selectra) and Cellcom; Togo gains Moov Africa. Bands of the new networks are unconfirmed unless stated. ⚠ Moov Togo’s B66 comes from two crowd-sourced lists; B66’s downlink overlaps 2100 MHz (B1), so it may be B1 misread — to be checked.

changes.zh: 工作线 C·补登：毛里塔尼亚新增 Mattel（Tunisie Telecom 旗下，2021 年 1 月开通 4G）与 Chinguitel（Sudatel 旗下，2021 年 8 月开通 4G），两家 2020 年 10 月获 4G 牌照（监管机构 ARE 年报，A 级）；频段与此前 Mauritel 的处理一致，只登记 B3 为“待确认”（Kimovil 所列多个频段更像牌照频段）。莱索托新增 Econet Telecom Lesotho（2016 年开通 4G，2023 年开通 5G），佛得角新增 Unitel T+（约 2022 年开通 4G），频段 B3、B20 均为“待确认”。
changes.en: Work line C, missed networks: Mauritania gains Mattel (Tunisie Telecom, 4G since January 2021) and Chinguitel (Sudatel, 4G since August 2021), both licensed for 4G in October 2020 (ARE’s annual report, grade A); as with Mauritel, only B3 is recorded, unconfirmed (Kimovil’s longer band lists look like licensed rather than used bands). Lesotho gains Econet Telecom Lesotho (4G since 2016, 5G since 2023) and Cape Verde gains Unitel T+ (4G since about 2022), each with B3 and B20 unconfirmed.

changes.zh: ★ 工作线 C·补登两国第一大运营商：海地新增 Digicel（2019 年与 Natcom 同获 LTE 牌照），频段 B4、B1 依现有来源登记为“待确认”；核查中厘清 2018 年 8 月获 AWS 1700 MHz 的是 Natcom 而非 Digicel。利比里亚新增 Lonestar Cell MTN（MTN 集团与利比里亚电信合资，2021 年开通 4G），频段 B3 登记为“待确认”。
changes.en: ★ Work line C, the largest operators of two countries: Haiti gains Digicel (LTE licence in 2019 alongside Natcom), with B4 and B1 from current sources marked unconfirmed; the review established that the AWS 1700 MHz granted in August 2018 went to Natcom, not Digicel. Liberia gains Lonestar Cell MTN (MTN Group with the Liberia Telecommunications Corporation, 4G since 2021), with B3 marked unconfirmed.

changes.zh: ★ 工作线 C·补登主要运营商：卢旺达新增 MTN（第一大）与 Airtel——监管机构 2023 年 2 月取消 KTRN 的 4G 独家批发权后，两家于 2023 年 7 月开通自有 4G（多家 B 级报道），频段 B3、B8 依现有来源登记为“待确认”。乌干达新增 Airtel（第二大），频段 B40（Kimovil）与 B20（乌干达通信委员会 2023 年向其分配 800 MHz）登记为“待确认”。★ 退网日历：卢旺达信息通信部宣布 2027 年 6 月 30 日关闭全国 3G 网络（A 级）。
changes.en: ★ Work line C, missing major operators: Rwanda gains MTN (the largest) and Airtel — after the regulator ended KTRN’s 4G wholesale exclusivity in February 2023, both launched their own 4G in July 2023 (several grade-B reports); bands B3 and B8 are recorded from current sources as unconfirmed. Uganda gains Airtel (the second-largest), with B40 (Kimovil) and B20 (UCC’s 2023 award of 800 MHz to Airtel) unconfirmed. ★ Switch-off calendar: Rwanda’s Ministry of ICT will switch off all 3G networks on 30 June 2027 (grade A).

changes.zh: ★ 工作线 C·新增国家：多哥（此前数据中没有该国）。补登 Yas 多哥（原 Togocom / Togo Cellulaire，AXIAN 旗下，2018 年 6 月获 4G 牌照），4G 频段 B3、B7、B20 依 Kimovil 登记为“待确认”。Moov Africa 多哥的 4G 网络已由监管机构测试证实，但目前唯一的频段来源写为 B66（在西非极不寻常，疑似有误），暂不建档，待找到可信来源后补登。
changes.en: ★ Work line C, new country: Togo (absent from the data until now). Yas Togo (formerly Togocom / Togo Cellulaire, part of AXIAN, 4G licence in June 2018) is added with 4G bands B3, B7 and B20 from Kimovil, marked unconfirmed. Moov Africa Togo’s 4G network is confirmed by the regulator’s tests, but its only band source lists B66 (most unusual in West Africa and probably wrong), so it will be added once a credible source is found.

changes.zh: ★ 工作线 C·补登遗漏网络（集团归属排查中发现）：塞内加尔新增 Yas（原 Free、Tigo，该国第二大运营商，2019 年开通 4G，Powertec 记 800 与 1800 MHz，EARFCN 属 B20、B3）与 Expresso（Sudatel 集团，2021 年获 4G 牌照），两张网络的频段均标“待确认”。多哥两张待国家条目建好后补登。
changes.en: ★ Work line C, missed networks (found during the ownership sweep): Senegal gains Yas (formerly Free and Tigo, the second-largest operator, 4G since 2019; Powertec lists 800 and 1800 MHz with EARFCNs in B20 and B3) and Expresso (Sudatel group, 4G licence in 2021); the bands of both are marked unconfirmed. Togo’s two networks follow once the country entry exists.

changes.zh: ★ 时效·品牌：AXIAN Telecom 于 2024 年 11 月 26 日把旗下运营商统一改为 Yas，马达加斯加 Telma、科摩罗 Telma 与坦桑尼亚 Tigo 三张网络改名 Yas，集团记为 Yas Group（AXIAN Telecom 2026 年 9 月起的公司名称）；欧洲投资银行新闻稿与 AXIAN 官网为 A 级来源。Etisalat：集团 2026 年 10 月由 e& 改回 Etisalat，阿联酋本部改名 Etisalat，三张网络集团统一为 Etisalat 集团；阿富汗子公司 2026 年 6 月刚改名 e& Afghanistan，是否随集团改回尚无消息，记为“e& Afghanistan（Etisalat）”并列入观察；埃及 e& 未宣布更改。⚠ 普查线索：数据中没有多哥的任何网络（Yas 多哥、Moov Africa 多哥），塞内加尔只有 Orange（Yas 塞内加尔、Expresso 未登记）。
changes.en: ★ Timeliness, brands: AXIAN Telecom moved its operators to the single Yas brand on 26 November 2024, so Telma Madagascar, Telma Comoros and Tigo Tanzania are renamed Yas, under Yas Group (AXIAN Telecom’s corporate name since September 2026); the EIB release and AXIAN’s own site are grade A. Etisalat: the group returned from e& to Etisalat in October 2026, so the UAE operator is renamed Etisalat and all three networks sit under Etisalat Group; the Afghan unit had only just become e& Afghanistan in June 2026 and there is no news yet of it reverting, so it shows as “e& Afghanistan (Etisalat)” and is on the watch list; e& Egypt has announced no change. ⚠ Census leads: no network at all for Togo (Yas Togo, Moov Africa Togo), and only Orange for Senegal (Yas Senegal and Expresso missing).

changes.zh: ★ 时效·集团归属（续）：六张网络更正。俄罗斯 Beeline 归 VimpelCom（VEON 2023-10-09 完全退出，A 级公告）；吉尔吉斯 Beeline 归国有 Eldik Bank（2025-08-13，品牌不变）；Vodafone 乌克兰归 NEQSOL Holding（2019 年 12 月起，与 Vodafone 集团仅为品牌合作）；匈牙利 One 归 4iG 与国有 Corvinus（2023-01-31）；丹麦 Telia 已于 2025 年 5 月改名 Norlys（Telia 集团 2024-04-02 完成出售）；MTN 叙利亚自 2021 年起由法院托管经营，MTN 集团 2026 年 3 月签署退出协议。⚠ 观察：叙利亚正招标一张新的 20 年期移动牌照以取代 MTN 叙利亚，结果公布后更新。核查中确认 Vodafone 阿尔巴尼亚未出售、卢森堡 Orange 未见出售报道，均维持原状。
changes.en: ★ Timeliness, ownership (continued): six networks corrected. Beeline Russia belongs to VimpelCom (VEON fully exited on 9 October 2023, grade-A release); Beeline Kyrgyzstan to state-owned Eldik Bank (13 August 2025, brand unchanged); Vodafone Ukraine to NEQSOL Holding (since December 2019, a brand partnership with Vodafone Group only); One in Hungary to 4iG with state-owned Corvinus (31 January 2023); Telia Denmark became Norlys in May 2025 (Telia closed the sale on 2 April 2024); MTN Syria has run under court guardianship since 2021, and MTN Group signed its exit agreement in March 2026. ⚠ Watch: Syria is tendering a new 20-year mobile licence to replace MTN Syria; to be updated when awarded. The review also confirmed Vodafone Albania was not sold and found no sale of Orange Luxembourg; both unchanged.

changes.zh: ★ 时效·集团归属：Telefónica 拉美撤退后的五张 Movistar 网络改记新股东（品牌暂不变）——阿根廷归 Telecom Argentina（2025-02）、秘鲁归 Integra Tec International（2025-04-13）、厄瓜多尔归 Millicom（2025）、智利归 Millicom 与 NJJ 的合资公司 Celtel Chile（2026-02-10 签约即交割，智利政府投资促进局为 A 级来源）、萨尔瓦多归 General International Telecom（2021）。乌拉圭已于此前改记 Millicom。哥伦比亚 Movistar（Coltel 2026 年 2 月起归 Millicom）已于 2026-10-14 并入 Tigo，此前已录入。
changes.en: ★ Timeliness, ownership: the five Movistar networks left by Telefónica’s Latin American exit now show their new owners (the brand is unchanged for now) — Argentina to Telecom Argentina (February 2025), Peru to Integra Tec International (13 April 2025), Ecuador to Millicom (2025), Chile to Celtel Chile, the Millicom–NJJ joint venture (signed and closed on 10 February 2026; InvestChile, grade A), El Salvador to General International Telecom (2021). Uruguay already showed Millicom. Movistar Colombia (Coltel, Millicom’s since February 2026) merged into Tigo on 14 October 2026, as already recorded.

changes.zh: ★ 时效：亚美尼亚两家更名。原“Beeline 亚美尼亚”改为 Team（Team Telecom Armenia）——Team LLC 于 2020 年 11 月从 VEON 收购后更名并完成品牌更换（运营商官网、IFC 项目披露为 A 级）。原“Viva-MTS”改为 Viva——MTS 于 2024 年 1 月将其出售给塞浦路斯 Fedilco 集团（MTS 投资者关系公告，A 级），公司 2024 年 3 月 25 日起更名 Viva Armenia，亚美尼亚政府持股 20%。Team 的频段（Powertec 记 B31 450 MHz 与 B3）独立来源不足，暂不确认。
changes.en: ★ Timeliness: two Armenian networks renamed. “Beeline Armenia” becomes Team (Team Telecom Armenia) — Team LLC bought it from VEON in November 2020 and completed the rebrand (the operator’s site and IFC’s project disclosure, grade A). “Viva-MTS” becomes Viva — MTS sold it to Cyprus-based Fedilco Group in January 2024 (MTS investor release, grade A); the company has been Viva Armenia since 25 March 2024, with the Armenian state holding 20%. Team’s bands (Powertec lists B31 at 450 MHz and B3) lack independent sources and stay unconfirmed.

changes.zh: 第二阶段：利比里亚 Orange 的 B3 按规则 C3 确认（Powertec、维基列表、Prepaid Data SIM Card 维基、Mobility Arena 一致，Orange 集团新闻稿证实前身 Cellcom 2016 年开通 4G；News Public Trust 的表述系转抄 Powertec，未计入）。吉布提电信 B3 确认（ITU 国别报告：2016 年起在 1800 MHz 铺设 LTE）；其 B20 仅 Phone Travel Wiz 一方明确，暂不确认。加蓬 Moov 与 Airtel 本轮未确认：两家都只有 Powertec 与维基列表两方（Operator Watch 对 Moov 的表述亦系转抄）。
changes.en: Stage two: Orange Liberia’s B3 confirmed under rule C3 (Powertec, Wikipedia’s list, the Prepaid Data SIM Card wiki and Mobility Arena agree, and Orange’s own release confirms predecessor Cellcom’s 2016 LTE launch; News Public Trust’s wording copies Powertec and is not counted). Djibouti Telecom’s B3 confirmed (ITU’s country profile: LTE rolled out in 1800 MHz from 2016); its B20 is stated only by Phone Travel Wiz and stays unconfirmed. Moov and Airtel in Gabon stay unconfirmed this round: each has only Powertec and Wikipedia’s list (Operator Watch’s wording on Moov also copies Powertec).

changes.zh: 第二阶段：刚果（布）MTN 的 B7 按规则 C3 确认（Powertec、维基列表、Phone Travel Wiz 一致，Ecofin 报道 2016-12-10 开通）。乍得 Moov（原 Tigo）的 B7 按 C3 确认（Powertec、Operator Watch、维基列表一致）；★ 乍得监管机构 ARCEP-Tchad 的第 12 次全国服务质量审计（2018 年 11 月，A 级）实测恩贾梅纳 4G 覆盖 Airtel 65%、Tigo 44%。未确认：Airtel 刚果（Powertec 称频段为推测）、Airtel 乍得（仅维基列表一方且带问号）、刚果（金）Vodacom 与 Orange（来源不足三方；Powertec 另记 Vodacom 有 B3、B28 载波，列为普查线索）。
changes.en: Stage two: MTN Congo’s B7 confirmed under rule C3 (Powertec, Wikipedia’s list and Phone Travel Wiz agree; Ecofin reported the 10 December 2016 launch). Moov Chad’s (formerly Tigo) B7 confirmed under C3 (Powertec, Operator Watch and Wikipedia’s list agree); ★ ARCEP Tchad’s 12th national QoS audit (November 2018, grade A) measured 4G coverage of N’Djamena at 65% for Airtel and 44% for Tigo. Not confirmed: Airtel Congo (Powertec calls its band a guess), Airtel Chad (only Wikipedia’s list, with a question mark), Vodacom and Orange in the DR Congo (fewer than three sources; Powertec also lists B3 and B28 carriers for Vodacom, noted as a census lead).

changes.zh: 第二阶段：布隆迪 Lumitel 与 Econet Leo 的 B3 按规则 C3 确认。Lumitel：Powertec、维基列表、Phone Travel Wiz 一致，Ecofin 转 TeleGeography 报道其 2016 年 2 月在六省开通全国首个 4G。Econet Leo：Powertec、维基列表、Phone Travel Wiz、FrequencyCheck 一致，ITU 国别报告证实其已开通 LTE（Operator Watch 与 DevelopmentAid 的表述系转抄 Powertec，未计为独立来源）。
changes.en: Stage two: Lumitel’s and Econet Leo’s B3 in Burundi confirmed under rule C3. Lumitel: Powertec, Wikipedia’s list and Phone Travel Wiz agree, and Ecofin (citing TeleGeography) reported the country’s first 4G launch in six provinces in February 2016. Econet Leo: Powertec, Wikipedia’s list, Phone Travel Wiz and FrequencyCheck agree, and ITU’s country profile confirms its LTE (Operator Watch’s and DevelopmentAid’s wording copies Powertec and is not counted as independent).

changes.zh: 第二阶段：贝宁 MTN B3 确认（ITU 国别报告：2016 年以 1800 MHz 开通 LTE）；SBIN（Celtiis）B3 确认（TeleGeography 经 Fierce 转载与 Communications Africa：前身 Benin Telecoms 2015 年以 1800 MHz 开通 LTE；Celtiis 2022 年承接该网络，Powertec 现行资料佐证）。布基纳法索 Orange B3 按规则 C3 确认（Operator Watch、Powertec、维基列表一致）；Moov 与 Telecel 只有一方写明 B3（Powertec 对 Moov 仅为推测），暂不确认。
changes.en: Stage two: MTN Benin’s B3 confirmed (ITU’s country profile: LTE launched using 1800 MHz in 2016); SBIN (Celtiis) B3 confirmed (TeleGeography via Fierce, and Communications Africa: predecessor Benin Telecoms launched LTE in 1800 MHz in 2015; Celtiis took over that network in 2022, as Powertec’s current entry shows). Orange Burkina Faso’s B3 confirmed under rule C3 (Operator Watch, Powertec and Wikipedia’s list agree); Moov and Telecel each have only one source stating B3 (Powertec’s entry for Moov is a guess) and stay unconfirmed.

changes.zh: 第二阶段：斯威士兰 MTN B3 确认（ITU 国别报告：2016 年以 1800 MHz 开通 LTE）；Eswatini Mobile B3 按规则 C3 确认（Powertec、维基列表、BTW Media 一致，BuddeComm 证实其已开通 LTE）。马达加斯加 Orange B3 按 C3 确认（Powertec、Kimovil、维基列表一致，TeleGeography 报道 2017 年 3 月开通）。马拉维 Airtel、TNM 与马达加斯加 Telma 本轮未确认：Airtel 只有两方写明 B3；TNM 的来源在 B41 与 B38 之间不一致；Telma 的 B3、B7 各只有一方。
changes.en: Stage two: MTN Eswatini’s B3 confirmed (ITU’s country profile: LTE launched in 2016 using the 1800 MHz band); Eswatini Mobile’s B3 confirmed under rule C3 (Powertec, Wikipedia’s list and BTW Media agree, and BuddeComm confirms its LTE). Orange Madagascar’s B3 confirmed under C3 (Powertec, Kimovil and Wikipedia’s list agree; TeleGeography reported the March 2017 launch). Airtel and TNM in Malawi and Telma in Madagascar stay unconfirmed: only two sources state Airtel’s B3; TNM’s sources disagree between B41 and B38; Telma’s B3 and B7 each have a single source.

changes.zh: 第二阶段：安哥拉 Movicel B3 确认（Fierce Network：2012 年 4 月开通、使用 1800 MHz，为非洲最早的商用 LTE 之一）；Unitel B3 按规则 C3 确认（Powertec、Kimovil、Operator Watch、维基列表一致，ITU 证实两家 2012 年开通 LTE；一份 2014 年旧博客记其首发为 2100 MHz，Unitel 当年曾演示 B1+B3+B7 聚合，不视为矛盾）。冈比亚 QCell、Africell 的 B3 按 C3 确认（Powertec、维基列表、Phone Travel Wiz 一致；监管机构 PURA 声明两家 4G 经其技术审查批准部署）。
changes.en: Stage two: Movicel’s B3 in Angola confirmed (Fierce Network: launched in April 2012 in the 1800 MHz band, among Africa’s first commercial LTE networks); Unitel’s B3 confirmed under rule C3 (Powertec, Kimovil, Operator Watch and Wikipedia’s list agree, and ITU confirms both launched LTE in 2012; a 2014 blog listing its launch at 2100 MHz is read as early information, Unitel having demonstrated B1+B3+B7 aggregation that year). QCell’s and Africell’s B3 in the Gambia confirmed under C3 (Powertec, Wikipedia’s list and Phone Travel Wiz agree; the regulator PURA states both 4G networks were deployed after its technical review and approval).

changes.zh: 第二阶段：多米尼加 Altice 的 B2、B4、B5 按规则 C3 确认（Kimovil、Powertec、维基 LTE 列表三方一致，载波聚合 CA_2A_4A_5A）；B8 另有 INDOTEL 第 070-17 号决议原文记其持有 941–960 MHz，暂留待确认。Viva 的 B4 因其曾被处罚违规使用 AWS 频谱，暂不确认。⚠ 观察：INDOTEL 于 2026-08-19 向 Viettel 分配 240 MHz（700 MHz、2.3 GHz、3.6 GHz），Viettel 将成为第四家运营商，开通后建档。毛里求斯：MTML（CHiLi）B3 确认（CMS《5G 监管指南》明确其以 1800 MHz 做 LTE）；Emtel B3 按 C3 确认。
changes.en: Stage two: Altice’s B2, B4 and B5 in the Dominican Republic confirmed under rule C3 (Kimovil, Powertec and Wikipedia’s cited list agree, with carrier aggregation CA_2A_4A_5A); B8, which INDOTEL’s Resolution 070-17 records it holding (941–960 MHz), stays unconfirmed for now. Viva’s B4 is not confirmed, as Viva was sanctioned for using AWS spectrum without authorisation. ⚠ Watch: INDOTEL awarded Viettel 240 MHz (700 MHz, 2.3 GHz, 3.6 GHz) on 19 August 2026, making it the fourth operator; it will be added once it launches. Mauritius: MTML (CHiLi) B3 confirmed (CMS’s 5G guide states it uses 1800 MHz for LTE); Emtel B3 confirmed under rule C3.

changes.zh: ★ 第二阶段·证据层（法属波利尼西亚、新喀里多尼亚）：ANFR 2026 年 9 月 1 日海外省表（A 级）逐格录入，合计审计一致。三张网络全部确认并补登漏登频段：Vini 补 B3（1800 MHz 在用 239 个站点）、B1（2100 MHz 221 个）；Vodafone 波利尼西亚补 B28（700 MHz 88 个）、B3（106 个）、B7（2600 MHz 70 个）；OPT 新喀里多尼亚补 B1（54 个）、B8（900 MHz 6 个）。三张网络页面显示各频段在用站点横条与获准数。
changes.en: ★ Stage two and evidence layer (French Polynesia, New Caledonia): ANFR’s overseas table of 1 September 2026 (grade A) entered cell by cell, its totals audited. All three networks confirmed, with the bands in service that were missing now added: Vini gains B3 (239 sites in service at 1800 MHz) and B1 (221 at 2100 MHz); Vodafone French Polynesia gains B28 (88 at 700 MHz), B3 (106) and B7 (70 at 2600 MHz); OPT New Caledonia gains B1 (54) and B8 (6 at 900 MHz). Their pages show the per-band bars and authorised counts.

changes.zh: ★ 第二阶段：乌干达 MTN 更正——此前登记的 B38（2600 MHz TDD）已过时，MTN 早已由 TD-LTE 改为 LTE FDD（band 7），据 MTN 乌干达客服账号的自述与 Techjaja 的报道补登并确认 B7、移出 B38；乌干达通信委员会 2023 年分配结果（A 级）另记 MTN 持有 700 MHz、2300 MHz TDD 与 2600 MHz FDD。哈萨克斯坦 Tele2/Altel 的 B3 确认（ALTEL 自己的演示：2012 年 12 月 25 日在阿斯塔纳与阿拉木图开通 LTE FDD 1800 MHz band 3，另有 Zakon.kz、Forbes 哈萨克斯坦）。
changes.en: ★ Stage two: MTN Uganda corrected — the B38 (2600 MHz TDD) on record was out of date: MTN moved from TD-LTE to LTE FDD (band 7) long ago, so B7 is added and confirmed from MTN Uganda’s own care account and Techjaja, and B38 removed; UCC’s 2023 award (grade A) also records MTN holding 700 MHz, 2300 MHz TDD and 2600 MHz FDD. Tele2/Altel’s B3 in Kazakhstan confirmed (ALTEL’s own slide: LTE FDD 1800 MHz band 3 launched in Astana and Almaty on 25 December 2012, with Zakon.kz and Forbes Kazakhstan).

changes.zh: ★ 证据层一期（法国）：本土四家的站点数由 2026 年 3 月更新为 ANFR 2026 年 9 月 1 日月报原文，并新增每个频段的“获准”数与在用状态（如 Bouygues 2100 MHz 获准 22,278、在用 19,001）；两张综合表逐格在加载时审计，合计与 ANFR 的“未计共址”总数一致。留尼汪 Zeop 按 ANFR 海外省表录入（其只在留尼汪运营）。⚠ 观察项：ANFR 11 月数据显示 Bouygues 2100 MHz 的 4G 在用站点一个月由 16,154 降至 10,271，正转用 5G。
changes.en: ★ Evidence layer phase 1 (France): the four mainland networks’ site counts move from March 2026 to ANFR’s 1 September 2026 tables, now with the authorised count and the in-use state for every band (e.g. Bouygues at 2100 MHz: 22,278 authorised, 19,001 in service); both summary tables are audited cell by cell on load and match ANFR’s totals. ZEOP in La Réunion entered from ANFR’s overseas table (it operates only there). ⚠ Watch: ANFR’s November data show Bouygues’ 4G sites in service at 2100 MHz falling from 16,154 to 10,271 in one month as the band moves to 5G.

changes.zh: ★ 证据层一期（日本）：总务省令和 8 年度电波利用状况调查（2026 年 10 月发布，截至 2026 年 3 月底，A 级）逐格入库——四家的逐频段 4G、5G 基站数（页面显示各频段 LTE 基站横条）、逐频段人口覆盖率与频段在用状态，每个数字在加载时经一致性审计；SoftBank 的 B28（700 MHz 4G 基站 3,836 个）、B11（1.5 GHz 11,133 个）、B42（3.5 GHz 25,177 个）与 B41（同集团 WCP 2.5 GHz 高度化 BWA 66,723 个）升为确认。docomo 的 3G 已于 2026 年 3 月关闭。
changes.en: ★ Evidence layer phase 1 (Japan): MIC’s FY2026 survey of radio use (October 2026, end of March 2026, grade A) entered cell by cell — 4G and 5G base stations by band for all four operators (the network pages show LTE base-station bars per band), population coverage by band and per-band in-use state, every figure audited for consistency on load; SoftBank’s B28 (3,836 4G base stations at 700 MHz), B11 (11,133 at 1.5 GHz), B42 (25,177 at 3.5 GHz) and B41 (66,723 advanced-BWA stations of group company WCP at 2.5 GHz) confirmed. docomo closed its 3G in March 2026.

changes.zh: ★ 时效专项：尼泊尔 Smart Telecom（Smart Cell）已关闭——2023-04-06 未续期、牌照自动注销，此后未运营，资产 2025 年 10 月被 Ncell 购得——移出在用列表；坦桑尼亚 Zantel 已与 Tigo 合并，TigoZantel 品牌 2024 年 11 月并入 Yas，网络并入 Yas；格鲁吉亚 Beeline 2023 年 4 月更名 Cellfie；瓦努阿图 TVL 2020 年 3 月起以 Vodafone 瓦努阿图名义经营（TRBR 原文）。
changes.en: ★ Timeliness: Smart Telecom (Smart Cell) in Nepal has closed — its licence lapsed on 6 April 2023 with no renewal, it has not operated since, and Ncell bought its assets in October 2025 — and leaves the live list; Zantel in Tanzania, combined with Tigo, saw the TigoZantel brand retired into Yas in November 2024, and its network merges into Yas; Beeline Georgia renamed Cellfie in April 2023; TVL in Vanuatu has traded as Vodafone Vanuatu since March 2020 (per TRBR).

changes.zh: 第二阶段（喀麦隆）：MTN 的 B41（TD-LTE 2500 MHz）按规则 C3 确认（五个列表一致；Africanews、Le Jour 报道 2015-12-16/17 开通）；Orange 的 B3 按规则 C3 确认（三个列表一致；TIC Mag 报道 2015 年 12 月宣布 4G，ART 称其 2015 年 3 月牌照已涵盖 4G）。Orange 的 700/800 MHz 已获分配但现网证据不足，仍待确认。
changes.en: Stage two (Cameroon): MTN’s B41 (TD-LTE 2500 MHz) confirmed under rule C3 (five listings agree; Africanews and Le Jour report the launch on 16–17 December 2015); Orange’s B3 under rule C3 (three listings agree; TIC Mag reports its 4G announcement of December 2015, with ART saying the March 2015 licences already covered 4G). Orange’s 700/800 MHz are assigned but lack in-use evidence and stay unconfirmed.

changes.zh: 第二阶段（塔吉克斯坦）：MegaFon 塔吉克的 B7 按其官网新闻确认（工作量最大的是 LTE 2600），B20 按规则 C3 确认；Tcell 按官网新闻补登并确认 LTE 2100（B1，索格特州 15 个以上基站），B20 按规则 C3 确认（2014 年 4 月商用，官网）；Babilon-M 的 B3、B1 按规则 C3 确认（三个列表一致，ITU 国别报告确认其 2012 年率先推出 LTE）。塔吉克 3 张网络全部有确认频段。
changes.en: Stage two (Tajikistan): MegaFon Tajikistan’s B7 confirmed from its own news (most of the work went into LTE 2600), its B20 under rule C3; Tcell’s LTE 2100 (B1, more than 15 base stations in Sughd) added and confirmed from its own news, its B20 under rule C3 (commercial since April 2014, per its site); Babilon-M’s B3 and B1 under rule C3 (three listings agree; ITU’s country profile confirms its 2012 LTE launch). All three Tajik networks now have confirmed bands.

changes.zh: 第二阶段（乌兹别克斯坦）：Beeline 按官网原文补登并确认 850 MHz（B5、B18）、900（B8）、1800（B3）、2100（B1）、2300（B40）、2600 MHz（B7、B38、B41）——此前数据只有 B7；Mobiuz 按官网确认 800/1800/2600 MHz；Ucell 的 B7、B3、B28（ZTE 700/2600 MHz 双频商用 LTE、TeleGeography 报道、2018 年 900/1800 MHz 技术中立）与 Uzmobile 的 B3 按规则 B 确认。乌兹别克 4 张网络全部有确认频段。
changes.en: Stage two (Uzbekistan): Beeline’s bands added and confirmed from its own site — 850 MHz (B5, B18), 900 (B8), 1800 (B3), 2100 (B1), 2300 (B40) and 2600 MHz (B7, B38, B41), where the data had only B7; Mobiuz’s 800/1800/2600 MHz confirmed from its own site; Ucell’s B7, B3 and B28 (ZTE’s 700/2600 MHz dual-band commercial LTE, TeleGeography’s report, the 2018 technology neutrality at 900/1800 MHz) and Uzmobile’s B3 confirmed under rule B. All four Uzbek networks now have confirmed bands.

changes.zh: 第二阶段复查（p737 降级的 5 张）：NT 泰国的 B28 恢复确认（NT 与 AIS 官方公告：AWN 在 NT 的 700 MHz 上建 4G/5G 网络供 NT 客户使用；曼谷邮报：2025-08-04 其他频段到期后用户已迁到 700 MHz），True 的 B28 一并确认（官方博客：700 MHz 4G）；WOM 智利（AWS 上的 LTE）、MPT 缅甸（2017 年 1800 MHz 商用 LTE）、Bitel 秘鲁（Tutela 实测：900 MHz 为主，1900 与 2600 MHz 各占其余一半；另有 AWS-3 与 2.3 GHz）恢复确认。⚠ 9mobile 维持待确认：2025 年 6 月起其用户经 MTN 全国漫游，MTN 可使用其 900/1800/2100 MHz，这张网络待按漫游方式改写（时效专项）。
changes.en: Stage two re-check (the five networks demoted in p737): NT Thailand’s B28 restored (NT’s and AIS’s own releases: AWN builds a 4G/5G network on NT’s 700 MHz for NT’s customers; Bangkok Post: users moved to 700 MHz after the other bands expired on 4 August 2025), with True’s B28 confirmed too (its own blog: 700 MHz 4G); WOM Chile (LTE on AWS), MPT Myanmar (1800 MHz commercial LTE since 2017) and Bitel Peru (Tutela’s measurements: mostly 900 MHz, the rest split between 1900 and 2600 MHz; plus AWS-3 and 2.3 GHz) restored. ⚠ 9mobile stays unconfirmed: since June 2025 its users roam nationally on MTN, which may use its 900/1800/2100 MHz; the network is to be re-described as roaming (timeliness item).

changes.zh: ★ 时效排查（2100 MHz 是否改为纯 5G）：除德国电信（2026-05 起纯 5G，p735 已撤出 LTE B1）外，未见其他运营商整频段改为纯 5G。观察项：英国 EE 已在 4,000 多个站点把 2100 MHz 转为 5G+，其余站点仍有 LTE B1，暂不撤出。德国 Vodafone、O2 的 2100 MHz 仍为 LTE B1（inside digital 2026 年频谱表）；1&1 的 B1 按规则 B 确认（同表：LTE B1 / 5G n1 DSS，加 BNetzA 2019 年分配原文）。
changes.en: ★ Timeliness scan (2100 MHz moving to 5G only): apart from Deutsche Telekom (5G-only since May 2026; LTE B1 withdrawn in p735), no operator was found to have moved the whole band to 5G. Watch item: EE has moved 2100 MHz to 5G+ at more than 4,000 sites, with LTE B1 still on the rest, so it stays. Vodafone’s and O2’s 2100 MHz in Germany remain LTE band 1 (inside digital’s 2026 table); 1&1’s B1 confirmed under rule B (the same table: LTE B1 / 5G n1 with DSS, plus BNetzA’s 2019 assignment).

changes.zh: ★ E 线结案（证据加固）：Verizon 的 B46 补上 Verizon 自己的 LAA 新闻稿与全国部署报道；TELUS 的 B5 补上其 40-F 年度信息表（持有 850 MHz 蜂窝频谱）；Tre 瑞典的 B1 补上 PTS 2023 年牌照决定原文；Telia 挪威的 B7 补上其 2009 年以 2.6 GHz 首开 LTE 的报道。经最后一轮查找仍无符合规则的来源的 14 条早期确认降为待确认（仍显示为可能在用）：台湾大哥大 B1、Viettel B1、MegaFon 与 Beeline 的 B38、Simba B38、inwi B38、秘鲁 Claro B7、Entel B4、Bitel B7、WOM 智利 B4、NT 泰国 B28、MPT 缅甸 B3、9mobile B3、Andorra Telecom B3。
changes.en: ★ Evidence-strengthening line closed: Verizon’s B46 now carries Verizon’s own LAA release and the nationwide-rollout reports; TELUS’s B5 its 40-F (holding 850 MHz cellular spectrum); Tre Sweden’s B1 PTS’s 2023 licence decision; Telia Norway’s B7 the reports of its 2009 2.6 GHz LTE launch. After a final search round, 14 legacy confirmations still without a source meeting the rules go back to unconfirmed (still listed as possibly in use): Taiwan Mobile B1, Viettel B1, MegaFon’s and Beeline’s B38, Simba B38, inwi B38, Claro Peru B7, Entel B4, Bitel B7, WOM Chile B4, NT Thailand B28, MPT Myanmar B3, 9mobile B3 and Andorra Telecom B3.

changes.zh: 证据加固（新西兰、瑞士）：Spark 的 B1、B7 补上 Spark 自己的原文（致 MBIE/RSM 意见书：2100 MHz 将越来越多用于 LTE；新西兰交易所公告：续期 1800/2100 MHz；致 RSM 意见书：2.6 GHz FDD 在城镇与乡村使用越来越密集）与 2degrees 的陈述；瑞士 Sunrise 的 B28 补上联邦政府与 BAKOM 2019 年拍卖结果原文（700 MHz FDD 10 MHz），Salt 与 Swisscom 的 700 MHz 一并挂上。
changes.en: Evidence strengthening (New Zealand, Switzerland): Spark’s B1 and B7 now carry Spark’s own filings (to MBIE/RSM: 2100 MHz increasingly used for LTE; to the NZX: 1800/2100 MHz renewal; to RSM: 2.6 GHz FDD used more intensively in towns and rural fringes) and 2degrees’ statement; Sunrise’s B28 carries the federal and OFCOM 2019 auction results (10 MHz at 700 MHz FDD), with Salt’s and Swisscom’s 700 MHz attached too.

changes.zh: ★ 时效更正（德国）：德国电信 2026 年 5 月起关闭 2100 MHz 上的 DSS，该频段只用于 5G（RCR、inside digital 引 CTO Alexander Jenbar、teltarif、Mobile World Live）。按“在用以运营商发布为准”，德国电信的 LTE B1 撤出，2100 MHz 记为 5G n1；德国电信 LTE 仍有 B20、B8、B28、B3、B7、B32。证据加固：捷克 T-Mobile 与 Vodafone、希腊 Cosmote 的 B1 补上关闭 3G、2100 MHz 转用 LTE 与 5G 的报道。
changes.en: ★ Timeliness correction (Germany): since May 2026 Deutsche Telekom has switched off DSS on 2100 MHz and uses the band for 5G only (RCR, inside digital quoting CTO Alexander Jenbar, teltarif, Mobile World Live). Following “in use per the operator’s own word”, Telekom’s LTE B1 is withdrawn and 2100 MHz is recorded as 5G n1; Telekom’s LTE keeps B20, B8, B28, B3, B7 and B32. Evidence strengthening: T-Mobile’s and Vodafone’s B1 in the Czech Republic and Cosmote’s B1 in Greece carry the reports of their 3G switch-offs moving 2100 MHz to LTE and 5G.

changes.zh: 证据加固（冰岛、南非、越南）与五处确认（马耳他、卢森堡）：冰岛 Síminn 的 B3、B7，Nova 的 B3，Sýn 的 B20 补上电子通信管理局频谱持有表原文；南非 Vodacom、MTN 的 B3 补上 ICASA 2013 年频谱使用报告原文，rain 的 B3 与 Telkom 的 B40 补上提交 ICASA 的材料与持有量报道；越南 Viettel、VinaPhone、MobiFone 的 B3 补上信息通信部 1800 MHz 4G 牌照报道。马耳他 GO 与 Epic 的 B7、Epic 的 B20，卢森堡 POST 与 Orange 的 B20 确认（官方持有原文 + 列其 LTE 在用的来源）。
changes.en: Evidence strengthening (Iceland, South Africa, Vietnam) and five confirmations (Malta, Luxembourg): Síminn’s B3 and B7, Nova’s B3 and Sýn’s B20 now carry the Icelandic regulator’s own holdings table; Vodacom’s and MTN’s B3 in South Africa carry ICASA’s 2013 spectrum usage report, and rain’s B3 and Telkom’s B40 the submissions to ICASA and holdings reports; Viettel’s, VinaPhone’s and MobiFone’s B3 carry the reports of the MIC’s 1800 MHz 4G licences. GO’s and Epic’s B7 and Epic’s B20 in Malta, and POST’s and Orange’s B20 in Luxembourg, confirmed (the official holding plus sources listing LTE on them).

changes.zh: 证据加固（卢森堡、马耳他）与一处确认（塞浦路斯）：卢森堡 POST、Orange、Tango 的 B3 与 Tango 的 B20 补上政府公告与 ILR 原文（2012 年技术中立牌照允许 LTE 并增配 1800 MHz；运营商以 1800 MHz 2×25 与 800 MHz 聚合；2025 年续期 800/900/1800/2600 MHz）；马耳他 GO 的 B20、B3，Epic 的 B3，Melita 的 B20 补上 MCA 牌照清单与 2026 年磋商文件原文（注意 Melita 只有 900 MHz，没有 1800 MHz 牌照）。Epic 塞浦路斯的 B7、B20 按规则 B 确认。
changes.en: Evidence strengthening (Luxembourg, Malta) and one confirmation (Cyprus): POST’s, Orange’s and Tango’s B3 and Tango’s B20 now carry the government’s release and ILR’s own documents (2012 technology-neutral licences allowing LTE, with extra 1800 MHz; the operators aggregating 2×25 MHz at 1800 with 800 MHz; 2025 renewal of 800/900/1800/2600 MHz); GO’s B20 and B3, Epic’s B3 and Melita’s B20 carry MCA’s licence list and 2026 consultation (Melita holds 900 MHz but no 1800 MHz licence). Epic Cyprus’s B7 and B20 confirmed under rule B.

changes.zh: 证据加固（摩洛哥、塞浦路斯）：摩洛哥 Orange 的 B20、B3、B7 与 Maroc Telecom 的 B3 补上 ANRT 原文（2015 年三张 4G 牌照各含 800 MHz 10 MHz、1800 MHz 10 MHz、2.6 GHz 20 MHz）与逐家牌照报道；塞浦路斯 Cyta 的 B20、B7 补上 2016 年拍卖结果报道（三份频谱包各 800 MHz 2×10、2.6 GHz 2×20），PrimeTel 的 B3 补上其 900/1800/2100 MHz 牌照报道。普查线索：Cablenet 2016 年获移动频谱，数据中缺此网络。
changes.en: Evidence strengthening (Morocco, Cyprus): Orange Morocco’s B20, B3 and B7 and Maroc Telecom’s B3 now carry ANRT’s own presentation (each of the three 2015 4G licences carries 10 MHz at 800 MHz, 10 MHz at 1800 MHz and 20 MHz at 2.6 GHz) and the per-licence reports; Cyta’s B20 and B7 carry the 2016 auction results as reported (each package 2×10 MHz at 800 MHz and 2×20 MHz at 2.6 GHz), and PrimeTel’s B3 the report of its 900/1800/2100 MHz licence. Census lead: Cablenet won mobile spectrum in 2016 and is missing from the data.

changes.zh: 证据加固（泰国、俄罗斯、尼日利亚）与一处确认（台湾）：True 的 B1、B3、B8、B40、B41 补上 True 集团官网原文（8 个频段持有量；2600/2300/2100/1800 MHz 同时承载 4G 与 5G）；MTS、Beeline、MegaFon、T2 的 B3 补上 ComNews 与 Fierce 报道（MTS 聚合 1800 FDD 与 2600 TDD；Beeline 发言人称 LTE 用 800/2600/1800 MHz；四家获准重耕 1800 MHz）；尼日利亚 MTN、Glo、Airtel 的早期确认挂上 Ookla（经 GSMA）的 4G 频段分析。远传的 B3、B7 按规则 B 确认。
changes.en: Evidence strengthening (Thailand, Russia, Nigeria) and one confirmation (Taiwan): True’s B1, B3, B8, B40 and B41 now carry True Corporation’s own releases (its eight bands; 2600/2300/2100/1800 MHz carry both 4G and 5G); MTS’s, Beeline’s, MegaFon’s and T2’s B3 carry the ComNews and Fierce reports (MTS aggregating 1800 FDD with 2600 TDD; a Beeline spokesperson naming 800/2600/1800 MHz for LTE; all four allowed to refarm 1800 MHz); MTN’s, Glo’s and Airtel’s early confirmations in Nigeria carry Ookla’s 4G analysis published by GSMA. FarEasTone’s B3 and B7 confirmed under rule B.

changes.zh: 证据加固（台湾）与补登（克罗地亚、比利时）：中华电信的 B8、B3、B7 与台湾大哥大的 B28、B3 补上 NCC 拍卖逐家结果报道（2013 年：中华电信 900 MHz B2 与 1800 MHz C2/C5，台湾大哥大 700 MHz A4 与 1800 MHz C1；2015 年：2500/2600 MHz 由中华电信等四家得标）；克罗地亚 Telemach 补登并确认 B20、确认 B7，HT 确认 B7，三家补登 B8、B1 待确认（HAKOM 措辞为“可通过……提供”）；比利时 Base 挂上 BIPT 原文与逐家频段报道。
changes.en: Evidence strengthening (Taiwan) and additions (Croatia, Belgium): Chunghwa Telecom’s B8, B3 and B7 and Taiwan Mobile’s B28 and B3 carry the NCC auction results as reported (2013: Chunghwa 900 MHz B2 and 1800 MHz C2/C5, Taiwan Mobile 700 MHz A4 and 1800 MHz C1; 2015: 2500/2600 MHz to Chunghwa and three others); Telemach Croatia’s B20 added and confirmed and B7 confirmed, HT’s B7 confirmed, and B8 and B1 added unconfirmed for all three (HAKOM says LTE “may be provided” there); Base Belgium carries BIPT’s own release and the per-operator block reports.

changes.zh: 证据加固（比利时、克罗地亚）与一处确认（秘鲁）：比利时 Proximus 与 Orange 的 B7 补上 BIPT 2011 年 2.6 GHz 4G 牌照原文，B20 补上 BIPT 2013 年年报原文与逐家频段报道，B3 补上 1800 MHz 分配与 LTE 使用的报道；克罗地亚 HT、A1、Telemach 的早期确认补上 HAKOM 官网原文（LTE 可通过 700/800/900/1800/2100/2600 MHz 提供）与 HAKOM 拍卖逐家结果。Claro 秘鲁的 B2 按规则 B 确认（报道称其 LTE 运行在 1900 MHz）。
changes.en: Evidence strengthening (Belgium, Croatia) and one confirmation (Peru): Proximus’ and Orange Belgium’s B7 now carry BIPT’s own 2011 2.6 GHz 4G licence release, B20 BIPT’s 2013 annual report and the per-operator block reports, and B3 the reports of the 1800 MHz assignment and LTE use; HT’s, A1’s and Telemach’s early confirmations in Croatia carry HAKOM’s own page (LTE via 700/800/900/1800/2100/2600 MHz) and HAKOM’s auction results per operator. Claro Peru’s B2 confirmed under rule B (its LTE reported on 1900 MHz).

changes.zh: 证据加固（秘鲁）与一处确认（斯洛伐克）：Claro 秘鲁的 B28 补上 Claro 自己的新闻稿原文（获 700 MHz B 块用于 4G）；Movistar 与 Entel 的 B28 补上 MTC 签约与 ProInversión 结果报道（安第斯通讯社、TeleSemana、EFE），Movistar 的 B4 补上其 AWS 4G 特许的报道。斯洛伐克 Orange 的 B3 升为确认（RÚ 决定原文列明其 1800 MHz）。
changes.en: Evidence strengthening (Peru) and one confirmation (Slovakia): Claro Peru’s B28 now carries Claro’s own release (700 MHz block B for 4G); Movistar’s and Entel’s B28 carry the reports of the MTC contracts and ProInversión results (Andina, TeleSemana, EFE), and Movistar’s B4 the report of its AWS 4G concession. Orange Slovakia’s B3 is now confirmed (RÚ’s own decision lists its 1800 MHz).

changes.zh: 证据加固（斯洛伐克）：Orange 的 B20、B3、B7 补上 RÚ 2022 年牌照变更决定原文（2013 年所得 800/1800/2600 MHz）；Slovak Telekom、O2、4ka 的早期确认补上 2013 年拍卖逐家结果（The Slovak Spectator：Slovak Telekom 800 与 2600 MHz，O2 800 与 1800 MHz，Swan 只获 1800 MHz）与 2020 年拍卖结果（Kinstellar）。
changes.en: Evidence strengthening (Slovakia): Orange’s B20, B3 and B7 now carry RÚ’s own 2022 licence decision (its 2013 800/1800/2600 MHz frequencies); Slovak Telekom’s, O2’s and 4ka’s early confirmations carry the 2013 auction results per operator (The Slovak Spectator: Slovak Telekom 800 and 2600 MHz, O2 800 and 1800 MHz, Swan only 1800 MHz) and the 2020 results (Kinstellar).

changes.zh: 斯洛文尼亚（证据加固与补登）：依据 AKOS 2021 年移动覆盖报告原文（逐家 LTE 在用频段与覆盖：A1 用 800/900/1800/2600 MHz、国土 93.1%；Telekom Slovenije 用 800/900/1800/2100/2600 MHz、97.0%；Telemach 用 800/1800/2100 MHz、91.6%）与 2014 年拍卖逐块结果，三家早期确认的频段全部补上 A 级原文；A1 的 B8、Telekom Slovenije 与 Telemach 的 B1 补登并确认。
changes.en: Slovenia (strengthening and additions): from AKOS’s own 2021 coverage report (LTE bands in use and coverage per operator: A1 on 800/900/1800/2600 MHz, 93.1% of territory; Telekom Slovenije on 800/900/1800/2100/2600 MHz, 97.0%; Telemach on 800/1800/2100 MHz, 91.6%) and its 2014 block-by-block auction results, all three operators’ early confirmations now carry the official original; A1’s B8 and Telekom Slovenije’s and Telemach’s B1 added and confirmed.

changes.zh: 证据加固（瑞典、挪威）：挪威 Telenor 的 B20、B3、B7 补上 Telenor 官网原文（2013 年拍得 800/900/1800 MHz，现持 2600 MHz 2×40，以 800 与 1800 MHz 建 4G）；Telia 挪威与 Ice 的 B20、B3 补上 PT/Nkom 结果报道（Telecompaper、Fierce）与 Telia 800 MHz 基站启用的报道；瑞典 Telia 的 B20、B3、B7 与 Tre 的 B20、B7、B38 补上 PTS 拍卖结果报道（Light Reading、Connectivity Business、Fierce）。
changes.en: Evidence strengthening (Sweden, Norway): Telenor Norway’s B20, B3 and B7 now carry Telenor’s own release (800/900/1800 MHz won in 2013, 2×40 MHz held at 2600 MHz, 4G built on 800 and 1800 MHz); Telia Norway’s and Ice’s B20 and B3 carry the PT/Nkom results as reported (Telecompaper, Fierce) and the report of Telia’s 800 MHz sites going live; Telia Sweden’s B20, B3 and B7 and Tre’s B20, B7 and B38 carry the PTS auction results as reported (Light Reading, Connectivity Business, Fierce).

changes.zh: 证据加固（瑞士、捷克）：瑞士 Salt、Sunrise、Swisscom 早期确认的频段补上 ComCom 与 OFCOM 新闻材料原文（逐家持有量与各频段在用技术：800 MHz 目前 LTE，900/1800 MHz GSM/UMTS/LTE，2100 与 2600 MHz UMTS/LTE）；捷克 T-Mobile、O2、Vodafone 的 B20、B3、B7 补上 ČTÚ 2013 年 LTE 拍卖结果原文，B28 补上 2020 年 700 MHz 拍卖结果报道（Novinky、Seznam Zprávy）。
changes.en: Evidence strengthening (Switzerland, Czech Republic): Salt’s, Sunrise’s and Swisscom’s early confirmations now carry the ComCom/OFCOM press dossier (holdings per operator and the technologies on each band: 800 MHz currently LTE, 900/1800 MHz GSM/UMTS/LTE, 2100 and 2600 MHz UMTS/LTE); T-Mobile’s, O2’s and Vodafone’s B20, B3 and B7 in the Czech Republic carry ČTÚ’s own 2013 LTE auction results, and B28 the reports on the 2020 700 MHz auction (Novinky, Seznam Zprávy).

changes.zh: 证据加固（土耳其）：Turkcell、Vodafone、Türk Telekom 早期确认的频段补上 BTK 原文（2015 年 4.5G 拍卖逐包结果：800 MHz A1 Vodafone、A2 Avea、A3 Turkcell；1800 MHz C1 Turkcell、C2 Avea、C3 Vodafone；2100 MHz 归 Turkcell；2600 MHz E1 Turkcell、E2 Vodafone、E3 Avea），Bloomberg HT 与 Mondaq 转载结果表。Türk Telekom 的 900 MHz（B1 包 2×7.6）补登 B8 待确认。
changes.en: Evidence strengthening (Turkey): Turkcell’s, Vodafone’s and Türk Telekom’s early confirmations now carry BTK’s own 2015 4.5G auction results (800 MHz A1 Vodafone, A2 Avea, A3 Turkcell; 1800 MHz C1 Turkcell, C2 Avea, C3 Vodafone; 2100 MHz to Turkcell; 2600 MHz E1 Turkcell, E2 Vodafone, E3 Avea), with the package table as carried by Bloomberg HT and Mondaq. Türk Telekom’s 900 MHz (package B1, 2×7.6 MHz) added as B8, unconfirmed.

changes.zh: 证据加固（加拿大）：Rogers、Bell、TELUS 早期确认的频段补上原文——ISED 700 MHz 拍卖结果（逐频块逐地区：下 700 A/B/C 对应 B12/B17，上 700 C2 对应 B13，非成对下 700 D/E 对应 B29）、BCE 40-F（Bell 的 700 MHz 与 AWS-3）、TeleGeography（TELUS 与 Bell 的 AWS-3）、Telecompaper（Bell 的 850 MHz）、Rysavy Research（三家 700 MHz 结构与 Rogers 的 AWS）。
changes.en: Evidence strengthening (Canada): Rogers’, Bell’s and TELUS’s early confirmations now carry originals — ISED’s 700 MHz auction results (by block and area: lower A/B/C map to B12/B17, upper C2 to B13, unpaired lower D/E to B29), BCE’s 40-F (Bell’s 700 MHz and AWS-3), TeleGeography (TELUS’s and Bell’s AWS-3), Telecompaper (Bell’s 850 MHz) and Rysavy Research (the three operators’ 700 MHz layout and Rogers’ AWS).

changes.zh: 澳门（第二阶段与证据加固）：依据澳门《公报》2015 年第 160、161、163 号行政长官批示（各家 LTE 牌照频段原文，证据 A）——3 澳门的 B3 确认，补登 B7；澳门电讯补登 B40 并确认（牌照含 TDD 2300–2400 MHz，报道称其是唯一同时采用 FDD 与 TDD 的运营商），补登 B7；澳门电讯与中国电信澳门的 B3 增加官方原文（早期确认加固），中国电信澳门补登 B7。
changes.en: Macau (phase two and evidence strengthening): from the 2015 LTE licences in Macau’s Official Gazette (Chief Executive’s dispatches 160, 161 and 163, evidence A) — 3 Macau’s B3 confirmed, B7 added; CTM’s B40 added and confirmed (its licence includes TDD 2300–2400 MHz, and reports name it the only operator using both FDD and TDD), B7 added; CTM’s and China Telecom Macau’s B3 gain the official original (strengthening early confirmations), China Telecom Macau’s B7 added.

changes.zh: 不丹与老挝（第二阶段）：不丹 B-Mobile 与 TashiCell 的 B3、B28 确认、证据 A（BICMA 2022 年研究报告原文：两家“已部署用于 4G LTE”的频率均为 1800 MHz 与 700 MHz；B-Mobile 的 B28、TashiCell 的 B3 为补登）；老挝 LTC 与 Unitel 的 B3 确认（老挝技术与通信部在 ITU 的报告：1800 MHz 以技术中立牌照用于 GSM 与 LTE；Unitel 2015-06 开通 4G），Unitel 补登 B5、B7 待确认。
