changes.zh: Vivo、Claro、TIM。巴西禁止外国卡长期漫游；Anatel 自 2025 年 4 月 6 日起不再认证只支持 2G/3G 的设备。
changes.en: Vivo, Claro and TIM. Brazil bans long-term roaming by foreign SIMs; since 6 April 2025 Anatel no longer certifies 2G/3G-only devices.

changes.zh: Telcel、AT&T 与 700 MHz 的批发网络 Altán。Telcel 的 4G 在 AWS（B4/B66）上；IFT 的规定要求 LTE 终端支持 B28。
changes.en: Telcel, AT&T and Altán, the wholesale network on 700 MHz. Telcel runs 4G on AWS (B4/B66); IFT rules require LTE terminals to support B28.

changes.zh: Orange、T-Mobile、Play、Plus。T-Mobile 已于 2023 年 4 月关闭 3G，Orange 与 Play 计划在 2025、2026 年底前完成。
changes.en: Orange, T-Mobile, Play and Plus. T-Mobile closed 3G in April 2023; Orange and Play planned to finish by end-2025 and end-2026.

changes.zh: KPN、Vodafone、Odido。KPN 的 2G 计划 2027 年 12 月关闭，Odido 的 3G 最早 2026 年 8 月关闭（监管机构 ACM）。
changes.en: KPN, Vodafone and Odido. KPN plans to end 2G in December 2027 and Odido 3G no earlier than August 2026 (the regulator ACM).

changes.zh: 物联网状态：按 GSMA 名录，TIM 已商用的是 NB-IoT 而不是 LTE-M；WindTre 的 NB-IoT 不在名录中，改为“未列出”。
changes.en: IoT status: per the GSMA list, TIM runs NB-IoT, not LTE-M; WindTre’s NB-IoT is not in the list and now shows as “not listed”.

changes.zh: TIM、Vodafone、WindTre、Iliad。Iliad 没有 B20（800 MHz），只有 B20 覆盖层的设备在 Iliad 上会受限。
changes.en: TIM, Vodafone, WindTre and Iliad. Iliad has no B20 (800 MHz), so devices relying on B20 for coverage are limited there.

levels.limit: allowed for a limited time, then a local profile
levels.operator: no legal ban; operators restrict commercially

roaming_policy.method: Four layers, cross-checked: (1) regulatory research benchmarks (Cullen International: Europe 31, Americas 11, APAC 7, Middle East 10, Africa 7, Q3 2026 update); (2) official regulator documents (TRAI); (3) IoT connectivity providers' country notes (Eseye/Kaleido, Hologram, IXT, com4, Soracom, 1oT, iot.cards); (4) IMEI-registration regimes as a separate field. Newer regulatory research outranks provider marketing; conflicts are kept in a note.

CL.en: Legally permissible (no explicit ban in most of the Americas); depends on operator agreements.

CO.zh: 法律上允许（美洲多数国家无明确禁令），取决于运营商协议。
CO.en: Legally permissible (no explicit ban in most of the Americas); depends on operator agreements.

PE.zh: 法律上允许（美洲多数国家无明确禁令），取决于运营商协议。
PE.en: Legally permissible (no explicit ban in most of the Americas); depends on operator agreements.

CN.zh: 禁止：外国服务商必须与持牌的国内运营商合作。
CN.en: Prohibited: foreign providers must partner with licensed domestic mobile operators.

IN.zh: 限期：电信部规定外国 eSIM 设备最长漫游 3 年，之后须转为印度运营商配置文件（转手须立即转换）；TRAI 2024 年建议缩短为 6 个月。
IN.en: Time-limited: DoT lets foreign-eUICC devices roam for up to 3 years, then they must move to an Indian operator profile (at once on change of ownership); TRAI recommended 6 months in 2024.

JP.zh: 总体允许：物联网可使用国际或跨国号段的 SIM 配置文件；运营商可能另有商业条件。
JP.en: Generally permitted: IoT may use SIM profiles with international or supranational numbering; operators may set commercial conditions.
JP.conflict: Some connectivity providers say Japanese operators expect a local profile.

KR.zh: 总体允许：物联网可使用国际或跨国号段的 SIM 配置文件；运营商可能另有商业条件。
KR.en: Generally permitted: IoT may use SIM profiles with international or supranational numbering; operators may set commercial conditions.

NZ.zh: 总体允许：物联网可使用国际或跨国号段的 SIM 配置文件；运营商可能另有商业条件。
NZ.en: Generally permitted: IoT may use SIM profiles with international or supranational numbering; operators may set commercial conditions.

AU.zh: 法规不禁止，但运营商在商业上限制长期漫游。
AU.en: No regulatory ban, but operators restrict permanent roaming commercially.

SG.zh: 实际上被禁止：通过牌照与本地运营商要求（Kaleido Intelligence）。
SG.en: Effectively prohibited through licensing and local-operator requirements (Kaleido Intelligence).

MY.zh: 受运营商政策和本地监管要求限制。
MY.en: Limited by operator policies and local regulatory requirements.

TR.zh: 禁止：《电子通信法》（5809 号）国际漫游上限 120 天，之后 SIM 与 IMEI 均被封；2026 年又强化远程 SIM 配置的本地化要求。
TR.en: Prohibited: the Electronic Communications Law (5809) caps roaming at 120 days, after which SIM and IMEI are blocked; localisation of remote SIM provisioning reinforced in 2026.

SA.zh: 禁止或严格限期：90–120 天后须本地 SIM 登记；物联网服务需完整电信牌照，SIM 开户需生物识别。
SA.en: Banned or strictly time-limited: local SIM registration after 90–120 days; IoT services need a full licence and SIM activation needs biometrics.

AE.zh: 实际上被禁止：须由本地注册运营商提供服务，SIM 开户需生物识别。
AE.en: Effectively prohibited: services must come from a locally registered operator; SIM activation needs biometrics.

QA.zh: 限期：监管机构新框架显示，无双边协议时入境漫游可能限 90 天；物联网类牌照即将推出。
QA.en: Time-limited: the regulator’s new framework signals a possible 90-day limit on inbound roaming without bilateral agreements; an IoT class licence is coming.

DZ.zh: 允许：通过双边漫游协议长期使用外国 SIM，没有专门的监管制度。
DZ.en: Allowed: long-term use of foreign SIMs through bilateral roaming arrangements, with no dedicated regime.

MA.zh: 允许：通过双边漫游协议长期使用外国 SIM，没有专门的监管制度。
MA.en: Allowed: long-term use of foreign SIMs through bilateral roaming arrangements, with no dedicated regime.

ZA.zh: 允许：通过双边漫游协议长期使用外国 SIM，没有专门的监管制度。
ZA.en: Allowed: long-term use of foreign SIMs through bilateral roaming arrangements, with no dedicated regime.

TN.zh: 允许：通过双边漫游协议长期使用外国 SIM，没有专门的监管制度。
TN.en: Allowed: long-term use of foreign SIMs through bilateral roaming arrangements, with no dedicated regime.

EG.zh: 允许但需审批：长期漫游须经监管审批并满足牌照条件；须由本国与外国运营商签署协议。
EG.en: Allowed subject to approval: permanent roaming needs regulatory approval and licensing conditions.

KE.zh: 允许但需审批：长期漫游须经监管审批并满足牌照条件。
KE.en: Allowed subject to approval: permanent roaming needs regulatory approval and licensing conditions.

NG.zh: 实际上无法使用：SIM 登记须绑定国民身份号码，外国 SIM 无法长期漫游。
NG.en: Effectively prevented: SIM registration is tied to the national identity number, ruling out foreign SIMs for permanent roaming.

RU.zh: 受严格限制：数据本地化与本地合作要求；外国 SIM 入境后数据与短信有 24 小时冷却期，2026 年起外国 SIM 使用被大幅限制、漫游流量按国内规则过滤（单一来源，建议核实）。
RU.en: Tightly restricted: data-localisation and local-partnership rules; a 24-hour data and SMS cooling-off for foreign SIMs, and since 2026 heavy limits on foreign SIMs with roaming traffic filtered like domestic traffic (single source; verify locally).

OM.zh: 限期：电信监管局 2023 年指令规定，使用国际 SIM 的物联网服务最多 90 天，提供商或进口商可申请例外延长。
OM.en: Time-limited: a 2023 TRA directive allows IoT services on international SIMs for up to 90 days; providers or importers can apply for an exception.

JO.zh: 需协议：长期漫游须由本国移动运营商与外国 SIM 所属运营商签署协议。
JO.en: Needs an agreement: permanent roaming requires a contract between the national mobile operator and the foreign SIM’s operator.

KW.zh: 未见明确禁令：监管机构没有公布长期漫游禁令；不直接面向本地用户的物联网连接可免牌照（单一来源，建议核实）。
KW.en: No explicit ban found: the regulator publishes no ban, and IoT connectivity without a direct local end-user relationship needs no licence (single source; verify locally).

ID.zh: 受限：本地牌照要求与数据主权法限制长期漫游（单一来源，建议核实）。
ID.en: Restricted: local licensing requirements and data-sovereignty laws limit permanent roaming (single source; verify locally).

TH.zh: 运营商限制：运营商通常要求长期连接使用本地 SIM（单一来源，建议核实）。
TH.en: Operators restrict it: they often require a local SIM for long-term connectivity (single source; verify locally).

VN.zh: 受限：本地法规与牌照要求让长期漫游很困难（单一来源，建议核实）。
VN.en: Restricted: local rules and licensing make long-term inbound roaming difficult (single source; verify locally).

PK.zh: 目前未见禁令：外国漫游连接现可不经本地实名接入；电信管理局 2026 年 10 月的规则草案拟要求实名核验、设 90 天门槛并监控长期漫游（草案，单一来源）。
PK.en: No ban yet: foreign roaming connections can attach without local KYC today; a PTA draft (October 2026) proposes KYC, a 90-day threshold and monitoring of permanent roaming (draft; single source).

UA.zh: 允许（依运营商协议）：2026 年 1 月 1 日起加入欧盟“漫游如在家”区，运营商可适用公平使用条款（单一来源，建议核实）。
UA.en: Allowed under operator agreements: part of the EU Roam Like at Home area since 1 January 2026; operators may apply fair use (single source; verify locally).

MD.zh: 允许（依运营商协议）：2026 年 1 月 1 日起加入欧盟“漫游如在家”区，运营商可适用公平使用条款（单一来源，建议核实）。
MD.en: Allowed under operator agreements: part of the EU Roam Like at Home area since 1 January 2026; operators may apply fair use (single source; verify locally).

AZ.zh: 首次接入本地网络（含国际漫游）起 30 天内须登记 IMEI，否则永久阻断
AZ.en: IMEI must be registered within 30 days of first attaching to a local network, roaming included, or it is blocked for good

UZ.zh: 漫游设备 60 天宽限期，之后须在 UZIMEI 登记
UZ.en: roaming devices get 60 days, then must be registered in UZIMEI

PK.zh: DIRBS：首次接入起 60 天，未登记即阻断（游客可免费临时登记 120 天）
PK.en: DIRBS: blocked 60 days after first attach unless registered (free 120-day temporary registration for visitors)

NP.zh: MDMS 白名单：停留超过 15 天须登记

KZ.zh: 2025 年 3 月起，境外购入的设备须做 IMEI 核验
KZ.en: since March 2025 devices bought abroad need IMEI verification

BD.zh: NEIR：2026 年 3 月起取消宽限期，未登记设备立即阻断
BD.en: NEIR: no grace period since March 2026; unregistered devices are blocked at once

TJ.zh: 未登记设备 30 天后停用
TJ.en: unregistered devices are suspended after 30 days

PE.zh: IMEI 登记窗口约 48 小时
PE.en: IMEI registry with a window of about 48 hours

CO.zh: 须向运营商登记 IMEI 并提供型号认证证明
CO.en: IMEI must be registered with the operator with proof of homologation

EC.zh: ARCOTEL 强制 IMEI 登记，须提供认证证明
EC.en: mandatory IMEI registration with ARCOTEL, with certification proof

CL.zh: 设备白名单（IMEI 须登记）

TR.zh: 外国设备 120 天后须登记并缴费（约 1,260 美元）
TR.en: foreign devices must be registered and pay a fee (about US$1,260) after 120 days

certifications.note: Certifications by market for the Hyper Nexus products. MF833V: Sept 2024 list (36 items, 30 markets). Dongle 400: every item on the 2021-11-18 status sheet obtained (owner, Sept 2026). F40: China domestic only; overseas per shipment. Certificate numbers are not shown on pages (they carry the ODM code). MF833V holds UKCA in the UK (owner, 2026-10-25); Dongle 400’s CE does not cover the UK (owner, Sept 2026).

dongle-400.zh: CE 只覆盖欧盟，不覆盖英国；英国 UKCA 按出货需求办理。
dongle-400.en: CE covers the EU only; UKCA for the UK is arranged to match shipments.

B66.en: Extended AWS (AWS-1 plus the AWS-3 blocks auctioned in 2015): a main US LTE band added in recent years
B66.zh: 扩展 AWS（AWS-1 加 2015 年拍卖的 AWS-3）：近几年新增的美国 LTE 主力频段

B71.en: 600 MHz: T-Mobile’s Extended Range LTE layer, in use since 2017
B71.zh: 600 MHz：T-Mobile 的扩展覆盖 LTE 层，2017 年起使用

B13.en: Upper 700 MHz C block: the backbone of Verizon’s LTE
B13.zh: 上 700 MHz C 块：Verizon LTE 的骨干频段

ID.en: Indonesia’s ministry (Komdigi) does not publish each network’s frequency licences: the bands here come from operator statements, cross-checked across several media (evidence B at most).
ID.zh: 印尼通信与数字部不公开逐网的频率许可：这里的频段来自运营商公告，并经多家媒体交叉核对（证据最高 B 级）。

closed.name: Smart
closed.why: licence cancelled; non-operational since; assets bought by Ncell in October 2025
closed.why_zh: 牌照注销，此后未运营；资产于 2025 年 10 月被 Ncell 购得
